items.quote: Audi, with the new launch that will happen in Q3, I think stronger numbers would happen in Q3.

items.statement: Revenue growth guidance of 20-25% for FY27 maintained; EBITDA margin guidance of 12-14% for full year maintained
items.quote: Our revenue growth guidance of around 20% to 25% remains intact. We also maintain our full year EBITDA margin guidance of about 12% to 14%.

items.statement: Order book stood at INR 1,801 crores as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: Our order book as on 30th of June 2026 stood at INR 1,801 crores, providing us with a very healthy base of executable projects for the year.

items.statement: Bid pipeline exceeds INR 6,000 crores with 50:50 domestic-international split; expects 20-25% hit rate for FY27 order inflows
items.quote: Our current overall opportunity pipeline is more than INR 6,000 crores with a broadly balanced 50:50% mix between international and domestic opportunities.

items.quote: Coming to around 3 to 5 years, we want to move this non-heating segment to around 40% of our revenue should come from the -- and that is the target we are having.

items.quote: Iraq now is -- we are coming up with a lot of projects in oil and gas and refining and petchem and allied areas, which is our core competence as well.

items.statement: Minimum gross margin to survive is 5-6%; most deals exceed this, generating profit

items.statement: Company executed LOI to acquire land in Palghar, Maharashtra to build owned facility replacing leased premises, aiming to save ~INR2 cr annual rent and enable 3x scale.

items.statement: Plans to invest in new machinery in FY27 to modernize and expand manufacturing capacity across business segments.
items.quote: In FY27, we plan to make investments towards the addition of new machinery to modernize and expand the capacity of our manufacturing capabilities.

items.statement: Appointed new US-based CEO with 32 years medtech/dental experience to strengthen US market leadership and scaling.

items.statement: AI-led automation initiatives underway (AI crowns in beta); initial costs higher but expected to normalize next year, supporting margin expansion.
items.quote: We are doing a lot of AI crowns already in beta AI models. So, there is some cost which is initial, which is coming in, which is slightly higher. But as we scale this up, you know, the cost will become much better.

items.statement: Targeting at least 25% year-on-year volume growth in LPG terminaling
items.quote: We like to at least grow in our volumes 25% year-on-year every year. That's our hope. That's how we work for.

items.statement: INR 10,000 crore capex program expected to be commissioned by March-June 2027
items.quote: So what you said 10,000 crores, I think we should reach by March or worst case June '27. So you will see all of that commissioned and all cylinders firing in '27, '28.

items.statement: Liquid storage capacity to grow from 1.7 to 2.2 million cubic meters in FY27 and near 3 million by FY28
items.quote: We are adding half a million by March, one or two months here and there. Half a million in liquid, another half a million to 1 million in FY28. So we jump from 1.7 to 2.2, 2.2 to maybe close to 3 by FY28 end.

items.statement: $5 billion capex target by 2030-31 funded by mix of debt (max 3.5x EBITDA) and equity (target $2bn net worth)
items.quote: But we, I think still remain very, very positive on that $5 billion capex objective that we have to complete by 2030-'31.

items.statement: 15-year take-or-pay agreement with leading conglomerate for >0.5 MTPA petroleum products at Pipavav rail gantry
items.quote: We have secured a 15-year take-or-pay agreement with a leading conglomerate for petroleum product handling, with committed volumes exceeding 0.5 million metric tons per annum.

items.statement: Operating EBITDA margin of 76.7% in Q1 FY27, up from prior year
items.quote: This translates into an EBITDA margin of approximately 76.7%, reflecting the strong operating characteristics of our terminaling business and the benefit of additional capacity coming online.

items.statement: LPG throughput tariff standardized at INR 1,175-1,200 per metric ton across all terminals
items.quote: We generally follow a standard rate of INR1,175 across our customer profile. But our principals may pay us a little bit more, maybe INR25 more to at INR1,200.

items.statement: Liquid terminal realization at JNPA of INR 6,000 per CBM vs blended average of INR 3,000
items.quote: You know JNPA gives you a realization of INR6,000 a year against your average blended rate of INR3,000. So that is what makes the difference.

items.statement: Ammonia terminaling realizations 2.5-3x LPG realizations despite lower throughput
items.quote: The realizations are 2.5 to 3 times the LPG realization. So that helps in spite of the lower ton that it is able to do.

items.statement: LPG demand recovery visible with July volumes at 80-85% of normal after geopolitical disruption
items.quote: We are seeing some, sort of, reduction in the shortfall that we have seen month on month. You know, so we in July probably we were down. Now, we are almost just about 80%, 85% of the normal that we were there earlier.

items.statement: Liquid revenue grew 31% YoY driven by new capacity maturation, mix change and higher utilization
items.quote: The growth in liquid terminaling was driven by higher volumes, capacity additions, and a more favorable product mix.

items.statement: Strait of Hormuz disruption risk mitigated by diversified sourcing (Argentina, Canada, USA, Nigeria) and multi-location terminals
items.quote: None of our ships were stuck in Middle East. We always were diversified in our sourcing. We have a very good partner in ITOCHU. We just don't source only from source of convenience.

items.statement: Mandatory 25% public shareholding by June 2028 to support $2bn equity net worth for $5bn capex plan
items.quote: I would almost with my second phase of equity which I have to do mandatorily to dilute to 25% by 2nd June 2028, we are confident that this $2 billion mark, along with this equity infusion and internal accruals, we will be able to reach.

items.statement: Expect high-teens overall volume growth for FY27 including North and GGBS
items.quote: we expect to deliver high teens growth at an overall company basis if I was to include North also as a part of this

items.statement: North operations targeting 60%+ capacity utilization by end of FY27
items.quote: we should be closer to 60% plus by the end of the year in terms of our North operations

items.statement: North plant expected to break even at EBITDA level in Q2 FY27
items.quote: in the second quarter, we should be EBITDA break even

items.statement: Capex guidance of INR2,300 crores for FY27 and INR2,000 crores for FY28
items.quote: this year INR2,300 odd crores, next year INR2,000 crores

items.statement: Long-term capacity expansion from 24.1 MTPA to 43.5 MTPA requiring INR7,500-7,600 crores
items.quote: our intention is to move from 24.1 million currently capacity to about 43.5 over the next few years. Now that requires about INR7,500 crores, INR7,600 crores capex

items.statement: Received approvals for over 29 large infra projects in Q1 FY27 with robust pipeline
items.quote: we have received approvals for over 29 large infra projects in quarter one. Moreover, the project pipeline is also fairly robust

items.statement: North-South cement profitability difference estimated at INR600-700 per ton
items.quote: The difference can be in the range of probably INR600 to INR700 per ton

items.statement: Expect fuel cost to remain flat in Q2 FY27 and decline from Q3 FY27 with domestic coal switch
items.quote: second quarter will be almost same as the first quarter, but going into the third quarter, we expect the cost to come down for us

items.statement: Cement trade mix stable at 51%, clinker-to-cement factor increased to 55% with North launch
items.quote: Within cement, trade mix remains stable at 51%. Our clinker to cement factor increased to 55% with the launch of North operations

items.statement: Net debt/EBITDA target maintained below 3.0x per board guidance
items.quote: the internal guidance for us from the board is to keep it below 3.0x

items.statement: PBT margin guidance of 14-16% for near term; aspiration to reach 17-19% beyond 2028 after new plant commissioning
items.quote: I would say we are being conservative. We are -- our aspiration or ambition is to try and get closer to 17, 18 or even 19. In the near term, as we -- investments, make investments, we think that there will be dip, right? Beyond 2028, we would start seeing this improvements.

items.statement: Planning INR 900-950 crore investment for new state-of-the-art Pune plant, production expected from 2028
items.quote: The sharper capital allocation enables making the investment plans we are making in terms of INR900 crores to INR950 crores we are planning to invest to make the new Pune plant, state-of-the-art Pune plant. And that is progressing as per plan and we expect to start producing there from 2028.

items.statement: Won INR 140 crore gearbox order (1-year supply) and INR 35 crore tractor OEM order; order book growing sustainably
items.quote: we just won a significant order with a gearbox manufacturer, INR140 crores order, which will help us significantly in our sales in the next few quarters, continuing to next year. Similarly, in agricultural, we just won a INR 35 crores contract with a leading tractor OEM

items.statement: Additional TRB channel to be added by early 2027; most new capacity tied to new Pune factory commissioning in 2028
items.quote: we are also -- again, even though we are constrained by capacity, we are still going to add one additional channel by early 2027, one additional TRB channel by 2027.

items.quote: Mr. Sujeeth Pai, who will be taking over as Managing Director of SKF India Industrial effective September 1st, as you see in the SEBI announcement, as I step into a role to manage the larger region for Industrial Region of India, Southeast Asia & Middle East within SKF Group.

items.statement: Pithampur facility on track for commercial ramp-up from Q1 CY2027; significant expansion headroom on ~30-acre site with only 5-6 acres utilized
items.quote: We are on track to ramp up commercial operations at this facility from first quarter of calendar year 2027 as we had previously guided.

items.statement: Gross margin improved sequentially by ~140 bps to 67.7% despite higher input and freight costs; achieved by exiting lower-margin contract manufacturing
items.quote: Our gross margin increased sequentially by around 140 bps to 67.7%. This is despite we have had sequential increase in key input cost, freight cost due to the geopolitical conditions.

items.statement: Operating EBITDA margin rose to 24.2% in Q1 FY27 vs 23.1% sequentially, despite higher input/freight costs and employee appraisals
items.quote: Coming to EBITDA, the operating EBITDA rose to 24.2% compared to 23.1% in the sequential quarter, which is again despite sharp increase in our input and freight cost due to the prevailing geopolitical conditions plus employee appraisals which have been concluded in Q1.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 tracking strong for sequential USD revenue growth after tactical measures in Q1 to improve gross margin mix
items.quote: But Q2 FY27 is tracking strong for sequential USD revenue growth.

items.statement: Received 2 product approvals in Q1; commercialization rate remains strong at 88%; several products to be commercialized in next 2 quarters
items.quote: We received two approvals in this quarter. The commercialization rate remains strong at 88%. Some of these products need to be commercialized in the coming two quarters.

items.statement: Pithampur FDA inspection resulted in 2 procedural observations; response filed and FDA approval received on regulatory filing post-inspection
items.quote: A 483 was issued with two observations which we had said we were confident of concluding the evaluation in a timely way. The observations were procedural. We are happy to report that we filed the appropriate response and also received FDA approval on a regulatory filing after the inspection was concluded.

items.statement: CFO Nitin Jajodia transitioning to Chief Commercial Officer; Rohit joining as CFO designate to succeed as CFO - part of management bandwidth expansion for next growth phase
items.quote: I'm very, very happy to state that Nitin who's currently the CFO is moving on to a Chief Commercial Officer role. And Rohit who will be joining us right now as a CFO designate but as Nitin transitions his CFO responsibilities to Rohit, Rohit would move into the CFO role.

items.statement: India store potential exceeds 10,000 stores with 6,100 unserved pin codes and 3,000+ densification opportunities
items.quote: India alone points past 10,000 stores now. The map has barely moved, and that is precisely the point.

items.statement: International EBITDA pre-Ind AS margin crossed 10% for the first time; profitability question mark is gone, focus shifts to scale
items.quote: EBITDA pre-Ind AS 116 margin reached 10.6%, up from 4.5% last year, with total number clocking to ₹127 crores, which was triple of what we did last year.

items.statement: Consolidated product margin crossed 70% for the first time after four quarters at ~69%
items.quote: consolidated product margin crossed 70% for the first time after four quarters at around 69%.

items.statement: India product margin expanded to 64.2% absorbing currency headwind; marketing improved from 5.7% to 4.8% of revenue
items.quote: The product margin expanded to 64.2% absorbing the currency headwind, and marketing improved from 5.7% to 4.8% of revenue on the basis of brand pull.

items.statement: International product margin expanded to 77.1% on deeper supply chain integration of Owndays and Meller
items.quote: Product margin expanded to 77.1% on deeper supply chain integration of Owndays and Meller.

items.statement: India same-store sales grew 18.3% YoY; same pin code sales grew 24% proving densification adds demand
items.quote: Same store sales growth was 18.3%, broad-based across tiers, and same pin code sales growth of 24% ran well ahead of it, proving that densification continues to lock incremental demand.

items.statement: Eye tests grew 42.7% to 63 lakh in India; remote optometry now in 786 stores up from 168 at FY25 end

items.statement: International eyewear units grew 37.6% and transacting customers grew 27.8% with only 16 net new stores
items.quote: Eyewear units grew 37.6% and transacting customers grew 27.8% while we added just 16 net new stores.

items.statement: Store capex ₹75 cr and plant capex ₹132 cr (largely Hyderabad facility) funded from ₹297 cr operating cash flow
items.quote: This was sufficient to fund our store capex of ₹75 crores and plant capex of ₹132 crores, which were largely pertaining to the Hyderabad facility, leaving a positive net cash inflow of ₹116 crores before M&A and equity raise.

items.statement: Talent and engineering culture identified as top long-term risk to executing 10,000+ store vision
items.quote: I would say it is talent. Talent and the culture, the speed of operation. items.statement: Medium-term growth guidance of 15-20% over next 3-5 years maintained
items.quote: We continue to maintain our medium-term growth guidance of 15% to 20% over the next three to five years and remain focused on delivering sustainable and capital-efficient growth.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 capex of INR 44 crores for center acquisitions and growth
items.quote: Our capital expenditure for Q1 stood at INR44 crores towards center acquisitions and growth.

items.statement: Annual clinic addition targets: 40-50 in India, 10-15 in Philippines, new international market every 12-18 months
items.quote: We have indicated in our calls that we intend to open 40 to 50 clinics in India every year. 10 to 15 clinics in Philippines every year. And we intend to open a new international market every 12 to 18 months.

items.statement: Added 26 clinics in Q1 FY27 (19 India, 7 Philippines), network now 550 clinics across 357 cities in 5 countries
items.quote: We added 26 clinics during the quarter, 19 in India and 7 in the Philippines, taking our network to 550 clinics across 5 countries and 357 cities.

items.statement: Adjusted EBITDA margin expanded 120 bps YoY to 23.1% driven by COGS improvement of 175 bps
items.quote: Adjusted EBITDA margin improved to 23.1% compared to 21.9% in Q1 FY26, supported by operating leverage and increasing share of international business whose base lies on our India model.

items.statement: Guest volumes grew 13% YoY to 38,262; treatments grew 13.3% YoY to 10.3 lakh
items.quote: As of June 2026, our active guest count stood at 38,262 compared to 33,868 as of June 2025, representing a growth of 13%.

items.statement: International revenue contribution increased to 45% from 30% a year and a half ago
items.quote: International operations now contribute around 45% of the revenue.

items.statement: Saudi Arabia remains in investment phase with binary tender outcome; losses may continue for 3-4 quarters
items.quote: Saudi right now we are in the investment phase. We are building foundation; we are preparing for the tender. We have built a team there, so the approach is to be ready for the tender when it comes.

items.statement: Working capital structurally high due to government reimbursement cycles; AR days improved from 121 to 101 days
items.quote: Compared to last year, our working AR days has improved from 121 days to 101 days. So, we have seen a 20-day improvement on the back of a lot of digitization, and a lot of AI work that we have done in the company.

items.statement: IPO proceeds utilization at 68% (INR 207 crores) as of June 2026
items.quote: As on June 2026, we have utilized 68%, which is about INR207 crores, from fresh issue from our IPO proceeds.

items.statement: Annualized adjusted ROCE at 21% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: Our annualized adjusted ROCE stood at 21% in Q1 FY27.

items.quote: I think a 20, the current number probably reflects a good proxy you can use. The numbers may fluctuate a little bit depending on the mix, but the current numbers are a good proxy.

items.statement: Network utilization at 74% consolidated level
items.quote: 74% is the number that we have listed at the consolidated level and that's a good reflection of all markets.

name: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Ltd

items.statement: Management guided for 30% year-on-year revenue growth in FY27 and expects to sustain EBITDA and PAT margins at FY26 levels by year-end.

items.quote: In addition, our board has approved an estimated project cost of up to ₹15 crores for the Gaudium Women Hospital at Lucknow, which will be incurred progressively over the setup and commissioning phase, with the commercialization expected in FY28-FY29.

items.statement: International patients contribute 25-30% of patient mix; medical tourism inquiries encouraging across new international spokes in Paris, Nigeria, Sydney.

items.quote: So our Janakpuri center has been growing roughly 30% year-on-year and is still growing. You know, Delhi is such a huge market and it is still growing at 30% year-on-year.

items.quote: This margin decline is mainly because of just one heavy marketing push that we did. This was a one-time marketing push which contributed to this difference. And this was done to basically market SiD and ERICA aggressively throughout the country.

items.statement: Management reaffirmed medium-term pre-sales target of Rs 15,000 crores over three years
items.quote: We are absolutely confident of our long-term guidance that we have given. We are all aiming towards that. We are building up our BD pipeline and also showing up on phase launches. We are very confident that we will be able to achieve that.

items.statement: FY27 business development target of Rs 10,000-15,000 crores GDV
items.quote: On an annual basis, I have guided you in the range over Rs. 10,000 crores to Rs. 15,000 crores is what we are aiming to do in this financial year.

items.statement: FY27 construction cost guidance revised to Rs 1,200-1,300 crores from earlier Rs 1,000 crores
items.quote: Yes, around Rs. 1,200-Rs. 1,300 crores will be the overall construction cost for the current financial year.

items.quote: We have more than about term sheets and advanced deals worth about more than Rs. 60,000 crores in the pipeline. These are reasonably split between NCR, Mumbai, Pune, and Bangalore.

items.quote: Around 25%-30% is what we expect. It is a very high margin, very high, very premium location.

items.quote: In Mumbai premium housing demand continues to be very stable, strong, growing, both in price terms and volume terms. So, we are pretty confident that we are betting on the right market.

items.quote: Our net debt, as I mentioned earlier, is virtually zero. So, in that sense, we do not have much debt remaining.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 collections robust at Rs 713 crores, up 31% YoY

items.statement: Birla Taranya achieved Rs 1,000+ crores booking value within 3 months of RERA approval
items.quote: Birla Taranya delivered an especially strong start. Within just first 3 months of receiving RERA approval, the project achieved booking value of over Rs. 1,000 crores, demonstrating strong customer acceptance and robust underlying demand.

items.statement: INR250 crores investment program over 2-3 years: SIOP capacity expansion from 30k to 45k tpa (Phase 1: +7k tpa by Q4 FY28) and captive power plant at Sahupuram by Q4 FY28

items.statement: Specialty Chemicals EBITDA grew ~20% YoY; margins ~35-36% on SIOP, CPVC margins dynamic due to PVC/CPVC spread volatility

items.quote: Domestic demand, however, remained reasonably resilient, supported by infrastructure, housing, water management and manufacturing activity.

items.quote: We have a guesstimate of maybe a swing from a sequential basis of around INR50 crores, INR55 crores on the PVC business.

items.quote: We expect our legacy long-term debt to fully be repaid during this year. Before incremental borrowings for new growth projects, we remain on track to become effectively net debt free by the end of FY27.

items.quote: We are targeting a minimum incremental ROCE of 20% on our new investments. We are not pursuing growth for the sake of growth.

items.statement: INR 8,000 crore revenue target by CY30 remains the north star, driven by organic growth (JVD, Volteron) and external acquisitions
items.quote: The INR8,000 crores target, it's not only a target for the complete organization and the management team, but this is the north stars we are following every night to find our way to success.

items.statement: Potential JVD order size in range of EUR 50-100 million

items.statement: Strong pipeline for new orders across India, Asia, Europe and USA; order wins expected before year-end

items.statement: Q1 FY27 standalone revenue INR 117.5 cr, net revenue INR 107.6 cr; PBT INR 12.54 cr; consolidated revenue INR 124 cr, net INR 114.17 cr, PBT INR 6.5 cr
items.quote: During the current quarter, the company recorded standalone revenues from operations of INR117.5 crores compared with negative of INR194 crores in the previous quarter. After accounting for profit petroleum and revenue share of INR9.83 crores, the net revenue stands at INR107.6.

items.statement: Crude realization improved to $95.5/bbl from $70.8/bbl QoQ; blended gas realization $12/MMBtu vs $9.8/MMBtu; B-80 gas $16.5/MMBtu, Dirok $12.5/MMBtu
items.quote: The average realization of crude and condensate improved significantly to about $95.5 a barrel, compared with approximately $70.8 per barrel in the previous quarter on a standalone basis. In addition, the average gas price realization improved to $12 MMBTU, compared with 9.8 MMBTU in the previous quarter.

items.statement: Kharsang production doubled to 17,400 BOE from 12,300 BOE; 5-6 workovers done, 23 more wells identified; 2nd 9-well phase rig award imminent
items.quote: Even from an operational perspective, the production from Kharsang has been most encouraging, where production increased from approximately 12,300 barrels of oil to 17,400 BOE.

items.statement: B-80 workover risk: subsea wells need rig for re-perforation; 2P reserves 26 MMBOE with 1.5-2 MMBOE produced; PY-1 drilling contingent on gas sales agreement
items.quote: We believe our 2P reserves are still there, 26 million, of which 1.5-2 million has been produced so far. So there are reserves to be produced. So we are giving it our best shot, we are planning properly, and we hope that we will be able to minimize the risk.

items.statement: Kharsang gas pipeline: 24 km route survey tender closing; 6-8 months for right-of-way, 6-8 months construction; target Dec 2027 completion
items.quote: All going well, we believe in six to eight months, we should be able to get the right of way. If we get the right of use for the way -- for the pipeline route, then it is another six to eight months, it's just a 24 kilometer pipeline to lay. If it were to be an ideal situation, we would believe that by the end of next

items.statement: Cambay assets: 20-30% production increase expected from belt technology at Balol and debottlenecking at Palej; sucker rod pumps ordered
items.quote: Then we have also debottlenecked our Palej facility to be able to increase production by using thermionic heaters and those kind of things. So overall, 20% to 30% increase in production we will see going forward, although we have already seen a 5% to 6% increase in the last quarter.

items.statement: B-80 FSO crude sale planned for Oct 2026 post-monsoon; 120,000-150,000 barrels via smaller tankers to avoid demurrage
items.quote: In October, we'll sell. In October, we'll have sufficient volumes for a small tanker to be able to take it and we'll be able to sell, but that would be around 120,000 to 130,000 barrel of crude we'll be able to sell in October.

items.statement: IGL Spirits targets EBITDA above INR500 crore for FY27 and aims to become debt-free from FY28, targeting EBITDA above INR1,000 crore in 4-5 years
items.quote: All of this naturally gives us a very encouraging outlook for FY27 and we expect to deliver an EBITDA in excess of INR500 crores.

items.statement: Chemicals business aspires to reach INR2,500 crore revenue and INR400 crore EBITDA in 4-5 years, with gross margins approaching 30% by 2030
items.quote: The aspiration that we are looking at is to deliver an EBITDA of about INR400 crores and a business which is approximately INR2,500 crores in the next four to five years.

items.statement: Ennature Bio Pharma aspires to achieve INR130-150 crore EBITDA over the next 4-5 years
items.quote: In terms of our aspiration for EBITDA, I think over the next four or five years, we are aspiring to do a INR130 crores to INR150 crores EBITDA.

items.statement: Chemicals business expects minimal capex of INR5-20 crore in FY27, with no major plant investment for next 2 years
items.quote: So, there may be incremental capex, but we are talking about perhaps INR5 - 10 crores, maybe INR15 crores, INR20 crores based on the plans that we have right now.

items.statement: IGL Spirits Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin improved to 22.9% (+207 bps YoY) for Spirits and 10.8% (+250 bps) for Bio-Fuel
items.quote: Spirits business had a net revenue of INR371 crores with an EBITDA margin of about 22.9%, which is an improvement of 207 bps.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 15.0% in Q1 FY27 from 14.3% in Q1 FY26, continuing multi-year margin expansion trend
items.quote: EBITDA margin is 15.0% versus 14.3% in the Q1 last year.

items.statement: IMFL volume grew 55% YoY to 1.4M cases in Q1 FY27; Prestige & Above segment doubled to 0.5M cases; mass premium grew faster than premium
items.quote: We have grown 26% year-on-year in terms of net revenue, doing 1.4 million cases, which is a 55% growth over last year.

items.statement: IMFL industry growing at 4-5% CAGR; IGL Spirits expects healthy double-digit volume growth in FY28 driven by new launches and geographic expansion
items.quote: The outlook for next year, we expect to continue to grow in healthy double digits.

items.statement: War-related disruptions: crude spike and freight volatility (5-20x) created both tailwinds (bio-EO competitiveness) and headwinds (propylene oxide shortage, Middle East/US export collapse)
items.quote: The war has impacted us in multiple ways, some good, some not so good. So, it is both a combination of headwinds and tailwinds for us.

items.statement: Bio-based EO pricing reached parity or slight discount to Reliance's petro-EO for several months, boosting specialty chemical offtake and glycol penetration
items.quote: We were either similar to Reliance's prices or slightly lower, which meant that we had greater off-take for specialty chemicals and greater penetration for some of the glycols.

items.statement: Thiocolchicoside sales grew 26% QoQ supported by strong order pipeline and improved price realization; nicotine sales doubled QoQ driven by European customer conversions
items.quote: Thiocolchicoside sales registered a robust growth of 26% over the prior quarter, previous quarter, supported by a strong order pipeline, improved price realization.

items.statement: NCLT approved demerger scheme on July 17, 2026; effective date pending; will create three entities: IGL (chemicals), IGL Spirits (spirits + biofuel), Ennature Bio Pharma (nutraceuticals + biopolymers)
items.quote: NCLT has now sanctioned the scheme of arrangement on 17th of July 2026, and upon effectiveness, the Spirits, Bio-Fuel, and Bio Pharma undertaking transfer to dedicated resulting companies.

items.statement: Chemicals NSU segment aspires to reach INR150+ crore revenue in FY27 and INR600-700 crore in 4-5 years with modular capex approach
items.quote: We aspire to be INR150 crores plus in this year. And we aspire that in 4 or 5 years, we see this business to be possibly INR600 crores to INR700 crores business.

items.statement: IGL Spirits targets doubling IMFL volumes in FY27 vs FY26 (3.4M cases) through deeper penetration in UP, Uttarakhand, Delhi and new brand launches
items.quote: When I look at the volume, we are looking at doubling our volume from what we delivered last year.

items.statement: Management expects VNB growth to outpace APE growth in FY27, implying margin expansion.
items.quote: We do intend to grow VNB at a faster clip than the APE growth.

items.statement: VNB margin expanded to 23.2% in Q1 FY27 from 20.3% in Q1 FY26, driving 33% VNB growth.
items.quote: Our VNB margin expanded from 20.3% in Q1 of FY26 to 23.2% in Q1 FY27, driving a robust 33% growth in the value of new business or VNB.

items.statement: Margin uplift driven ~70% by favorable yield curve and ~30% by protection mix and operating leverage; GST impact largely behind.
items.quote: Now, in this 3% approximate increase, you can say 30% is linked to mix around protection and some bit of operating leverage and around 70%, you can say is the yield curve, which actually has also helped offset the GST impact.

items.statement: Policyholder operating expense ratio improved 185 bps YoY to 16% of GWP; opex grew only 7% vs 19% GWP growth.
items.quote: Policyholder operating expense as a percentage of GWP has improved by 185 basis points year -on-year to touch 16%, driven by focused productivity enhancement initiatives. Despite a healthy business growth, policyholder operating expense increased by only 7% during the quarter.

items.statement: Axis Bank infused INR 381 crore for 0.98% stake (now 19.99%), raising solvency to 198%; MFSL has enabling QIP approval (INR 1,600 cr) valid till May 2027 but no immediate need.
items.quote: We achieved a key milestone during the quarter with the completion of Axis Bank's acquisition of an additional 0.98% stake in Axis Max Life Insurance through an equity infusion of INR381 crore, increasing its shareholding to 19.99%... The infusion enhanced our financial strength, raising our solvency ratio to a robust

items.statement: Solvency at 198% (regulatory min 150%), internal risk threshold ~180%; can sustain 2-3 quarters without fresh capital; sub-debt of ~INR 480-490 cr redeemed July 31, will be re-raised.
items.quote: Our solvency is, as, as you are aware, the regulatory threshold of the solvency is 150 %. 198% is fairly well above the regulatory minima and also above our internal thresholds that we derive from a risk principal perspective.

items.statement: Persistency: 13-month at 83%; longer tenure (37/49/61 month) improving on premium and policy count basis; NPS improved to 63 (touchpoint 65, relationship 61).
items.quote: Our 13 -month premium persistency stood at 83%. Additionally, longer tenure persistency metrics, including 37th month, 49th month and 61st month persistency, continued to improve on both premium and number of policy bases.

items.statement: Offline proprietary APE grew 9% impacted by voluntary policy cancellations for quality; excluding that, growth robust; advisor recruitment up, top advisor premium +28%, FLS productivity +7%.
items.quote: On offline proprietary, to be very honest, I mean it is a small quarter and there were certain one -offs related to certain specific very consciously thought through cancellation that we had to undertake, which actually impacted the numbers.

items.statement: Dynamic repricing based on yield curve; June curve ~50bps lower at long end vs March may unwind some Q1 yield benefit in Q2, but operating leverage and mix to support VNB>APE growth.
items.quote: Your observation is correct. You are saying that at the end of the June, the curve has moved, which could take away not the entire, but some benefits that were available in the first quarter from a yield curve perspective.

items.statement: Online proprietary diversified: ~45% of Q1 sales outside largest aggregator (up from 38% YoY); D2C engine strong with good customer quality from Tier 2/3 markets.
items.quote: Actually, only, almost 45% of the sales in quarter one were outside this large aggregator. This number was 38% in the last year quarter one. So this number has clearly grown.

items.statement: Revenue, EBITDA and PAT growth guidance of more than 25% YoY for FY27
items.quote: The company is maintaining its guidance of an increase in turnover of more than 25% compared to the corresponding period in the last financial year.

items.statement: Order book stands at INR5,100 crores with INR1,251 crores legacy projects and balance at 10%+ margins
items.quote: Our order book today stands at approximately INR5,100 crores, providing healthy medium-term revenue visibility. items.statement: Order intake guidance of more than INR5,000 crores for FY27, with INR1,293 crores booked in Q1 and INR212 crores L1
items.quote: The company is hopeful of surpassing its guidance of more than INR5,000 crores in order intake in the current financial year, against which we have taken INR1,293 crores order in Q1 and are L1 in INR 212 crores of orders.

items.statement: BESS manufacturing facility 2.5 GW phase ready, expansion to 5 GW and 600 container units by H1 FY28 with INR236 crores total capex fully financed
items.quote: We expect the capacity enhancement from 2.5 gigawatt to 5 gigawatt along with the container facility expansion to be completed in the first half of FY 2028, along with the order for the associate facility, which addresses a market potential of 208 gigawatt by 2030.

items.statement: BESS revenue target of INR200-300 crores in Q4 FY27 from NTPC order subject to design approvals by December
items.quote: So if everything goes right, then we can expect 200 crores to 300 crores of BESS order execution into this financial year.

items.statement: New orders only accepted at 10%+ EBITDA margins; Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin improved to 10% from 9% YoY
items.quote: As a strategy, at this moment, we don't take any order less than 10%. So it is always more than 10%.

items.statement: Price variation clauses in all contracts to neutralize currency, steel and lithium price fluctuations
items.quote: As a strategy, we have made it very clear that we will keep a PV (price variation) clause in all our contracts. Our expertise is in execution, and that is where we will continue to focus and take calls. Everything else, whether it's a steel price increase, a dollar/currency increase, or a lithium price increase, all of

items.statement: Legacy debt of INR375 crores backed by INR678 crores arbitration award; targeting INR300 crores NARCL repayment in FY27
items.quote: We are targeting few arbitration award also into this financial year that will further reduce our liability to the NARCL. So we are expecting roughly around INR300 crores of left this NARCL payment after the completion into this financial year.

items.statement: Pipeline of 134 upcoming projects worth INR98,725 crores across 11 states, 80%+ in irrigation and water supply
items.quote: On the water and power front, we track a pipeline of about 134 upcoming projects, worth close to INR98,725 crores across 11 states, with irrigation and water supply making up over 80% of this value.

items.statement: Credit facility enhanced from INR505 crores to INR860 crores from PSU bank plus INR300 crores surety bond line
items.quote: We have also enhanced our credit facility of INR505 crores to INR860 crores from reputed PSU bank, the documentation of which is under process and approx INR300 crores surety bond line, ensuring adequate liquidity.

items.statement: Promoters infused INR400 crores over 3 years; net worth doubled from INR500 crores to over INR1,000 crores; debt-to-equity improved from 1.1x to 0.4x
items.quote: Our promoters have infused approx INR400 crores during the last 3 years, helping our net worth double from approximately INR500 crores to over INR1,000 crores, while our debt-to-equity ratio has improved from 1.1x to 0.4x now.

items.statement: Legacy orders of INR1,251 crores to be executed mostly in FY27 and FY28
items.quote: This will be executed this year and next year, most of the legacy order will be executed.

items.statement: BESS plant revenue potential: INR2,000-2,500 crores at 2.5 GW, INR4,500-5,000 crores at 5 GW capacity
items.quote: Basically, if it is a 2.5 gigawatt, it is -- revenue guidance will be between 2,000 crores to 2,500 crores. If it is a 5 gigawatt, it is roughly around 4,500 crores to 5,000.

items.statement: FY27 revenue guidance INR7,800-8,000 crore, 23-27% growth
items.quote: Revenue, we should do between INR7,800 crores to INR8,000 crores, which is a growth of 23% to 27%.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 order bookings US$339 million; record backlog US$950 million, up 83% YoY
items.quote: The quarter also saw our order bookings of US$339 million, taking our order backlog to a record ever of approximately US$950 million, up 83% year-on-year.

items.statement: Plans to onboard nearly 2,000 professionals to support execution at scale
items.quote: We continue to hire and train talent at scale with plans to onboard nearly 2,000 professionals, ensuring that we have the resources required to support our customers' long-term growth plans.

items.statement: Strong demand across AI-led digital infrastructure, data centers, enterprise networking, managed services, cybersecurity
items.quote: We continue to see strong customer spending across AI-led digital infrastructure, data centers, enterprise networking, managed services and cybersecurity, giving us confidence in the sustainability of our growth pipeline.

items.statement: Non-hyperscale enterprise growing at modest double-digit ~10%; data center hyperscale driving 25% blended growth
items.quote: The non-hyperscale enterprise will grow at modest double-digit 10% odd. Combining, we are putting at 25% odd at this time.

items.statement: Operating cash flow to EBITDA conversion expected to improve meaningfully in FY27 vs FY26
items.quote: For FY27, we expect our operating cash flow to EBITDA conversion to improve meaningfully over FY26, supported by disciplined working capital management.

items.statement: Tax rate expected 10-15% for FY27 and FY28 due to carryforward losses; regularizing to ~20% thereafter
items.quote: For FY27 and FY28, I'm expecting it to be in the range between 10% to 15% and after that, it should regularize to around 20% type of levels.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 highest ever quarterly revenue INR1,719 crore, up 24% YoY; EBITDA INR160 crore, up 38% YoY; PAT INR56 crore, up 18% YoY
items.quote: Quarter one of FY27 was one of our strongest quarters as we reported highest ever revenue of INR1,719 crores, representing a 24% year-on-year growth. EBITDA increased to INR160 crores, up 38% year-on-year, while profit after-tax grew to INR56 crores, an increase of 18%.

items.statement: Aspires to improve UCP EBIT margins towards 7%+ over next 8 quarters, driven by cost optimization, scale benefits, and past capex investments
items.quote: So whether there's a room for improvement going forward over a long period of time over the next 8 quarters or so, the answer is certainly yes, actually because that eventually, we've had margins of upward of 7% in these quarters earlier.

items.statement: Segment B (Electromechanical Projects) carryover order book at Rs 6,345 crores as of June 30, 2026, providing revenue visibility
items.quote: As of 30th June 2026, the total carryover order book value for segment B stood at Rs. 6,345 crores, providing revenue visibility and underpinning the Company's confidence in the long-term prospects.

items.statement: UCP EBIT margin improved to 5.3% in Q1 FY27 from 3.7% in Q1 FY26 despite 10-12% cost inflation; near-full cost pass-through achieved
items.quote: Segment A margins improved significantly compared with the previous year despite commodity inflation and currency depreciation. These pressures were partially mitigated through progressive price increases and comprehensive cost optimization program.

items.statement: Total cost inflation 10-12% (7-8% from BEE table change, 4-5% from commodities/freight/FX); passed on nearly all to market, holding only 1-2% if any
items.quote: All that added up to another sort of 4% to 5%. And so overall, all put together, 10% to 12% was the cost, and we have also passed on very close to that number into the market, maybe a percentage or 2 lesser, if at all.

items.statement: RAC industry primary volume growth estimated at 20-22% in Q1 FY27; Voltas volumes grew 45% YoY, gaining share from 15.9% to 17.3%
items.quote: My sense is the primary increase would be anywhere between 20% to 22% in volume terms and maybe around 25% to 26% in value terms, maybe the industry growth.

items.statement: RAC mix steady at ~75% in-house / 25% OEM for Split ACs; Window ACs (10% of sales) fully outsourced; no shift expected
items.quote: In the Split AC bucket, we will have that 75-25 kind of mix. That will continue.

items.statement: Segment B margins soft in Q1 due to execution challenges and calibrated order booking; recovery expected from Q3 FY27 as shorter-gestation private sector projects ramp up
items.quote: Maybe Q2 also may not be very much better. But I think post that, Q3, Q4, I think, is when we feel that it should get really better. And I think that's where the recovery should ideally happen.

items.statement: Chennai (1.5m) and Pantnagar (1.4m) RAC plants fully operational; no major capex for Voltas standalone in FY27-28; maintenance capex only
items.quote: We already had done the capex for Chennai a couple of years back, as you know, the benefits that we are sort of yielding now. It will be more a maintenance capex that we will sort of continue to have.

items.statement: Expect motor OD loss ratio below 80% over time through corrective actions
items.quote: We are reasonably confident that we will bring the OD loss ratio below 80% over a period of time.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 combined ratio at 120.4%, up from 115.2% in FY26 due to motor reserve strengthening, OD claims, and large fire loss
items.quote: For the quarter, our net earned premium stood at approximately Rs.1,671 crore. The claims ratio increased to 85.6%, compared to 81.3% in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. The combined ratio stood at 120.4%, reflecting the impact of higher motor reserve strengthening, elevated motor OD claims experience, a

items.statement: Motor TP reserves increased due to claims inflation assumptions, not pure reserve strengthening
items.quote: The increase that you are seeing is largely driven by the claims inflation assumptions that need to be factored into the reserving estimates. Therefore, I would not characterize this purely as reserve strengthening.

items.statement: Commercial lines declined 8.6% in Q1 FY27 due to fire pricing pressure; fire line industry-wide decline ~28%, Chola MS decline limited to 15.5%
items.quote: The commercial lines portfolio recorded a decline of 8.6% in Q1, primarily due to continued pricing pressure in the fire segment. items.statement: Industry CAT losses estimated at Rs.3,000-4,000 crore; multiple separate events may accelerate pricing discipline in commercial lines
items.quote: Industry estimates suggest that the aggregate loss impact from the multiple CAT events could be in the range of Rs.3,000 crore to Rs.4,000 crore.

items.statement: No provision taken for Supreme Court homemaker judgment; matter sub judice with review petition filed by General Insurance Council
items.quote: We have not taken any provision during the quarter in relation to the Supreme Court judgment. We are closely monitoring the situation, given that the matter remains sub judice and, as you are aware, a review petition has been filed.

items.statement: Completed motor issuance platform rollout across bank channel; implementing workflow enhancements in motor claims; preparing for Ind AS, RBC, DPDP implementation
items.quote: We have completed the rollout of our motor issuance platform across the bank channel and are now implementing workflow enhancements within the motor claims process to improve efficiency and customer experience. items.quote: Our investment portfolio remains strong at approximately Rs.19,000 crore and generated investment income of around Rs.380 crore during the quarter. items.statement: Aim to complete Kendriya Bhandar order by end of Q2 FY27
items.quote: by end of the quarter, we aim to complete the entire thing

items.statement: Industrial Machines gross margin value up 15% and percentage up ~5% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: The absolute Gross Margin went up by 15%, and in percentage terms it went up by approximately 5%.

items.statement: Appliances segment result lower by Rs 74 lakhs YoY due to EPR impact and market expansion investments
items.quote: the segment result is lower by approximately Rs.74 lakhs compared to last year Ql, mainly due to the impact of EPR and our investment in strengthening organization

items.statement: EPR cost of Rs 1.2 crores in Q1 FY27 proportionate for full year
items.quote: The absolute amount of EPR is approximately Rs. 1.2 crores for this quarter, and this is proportionate for the year.

items.statement: Targeting EBIT breakeven in Appliances segment next fiscal year (FY28)
items.quote: Our goal is to become very quickly EBIT breakeven. But I think that's going to happen next year.

items.statement: Industrial Sewing Machine demand outlook mixed due to commodity price pressure vs garment sector growth; Singer gaining market share
items.quote: one is the commodity pressure, which is creating a lot of pressure on the price, which dampens the demand and on the other side, is lot of encouragement on garment manufacturing

items.quote: The ZigZag Sewing Machine is approximately 20%, Black Sewing Machines put together is approximately 50%, and around 30% is the Industrial Sewing Machine and the accessories.

items.statement: Reaffirmed FY2027 guidance for acquired group: EUR 700M revenue and EUR 35M EBITDA; not revising despite strong Q1 due to geopolitical uncertainty
items.quote: We feel very confident to deliver the numbers, which we had stated and we have given a turnover guidance of Eur 700 million and EBITDA of EUR 35 million for the acquired group . items.statement: Expects value capture benefits mainly in FY2027-FY2028, with some flowing into FY2029
items.quote: The second is the value capture will be continuous, we will be delivering more value capture in terms of FY2027-FY2028, major portion will be FY2027-FY2028, some will be, of course, some of the 2028 value capture will also flow into the 2029.

items.statement: Acquired group EBITDA margin target is high single digits to low double digits, not legacy 15%+
items.value: high single digits to low double digits
items.quote: For our guidance which we have been given, I do not think the guidance would be 15% but the area where we would want to look at how far the acquired group is in high single digits or low double digits.

items.statement: Gross margin expected to sustain at 50%+ range; Q1 increase of ~2% driven by cost reduction in yields, utilities, production
items.quote: So I would say that we should continue to be in the range of 50% plus of gross margin.

items.statement: No substantial capex needed for volume growth; moderate capex only for special initiatives like backward integration based on ROI
items.quote: From a volume perspective, we do not need any new capex we have enough capacities to grow on the numbers which we have indicated; however, we are looking at some special initiative, either backward integration or special projects and these are determined by the ROI and if the return is good we are going to do this. items.quote: As our net debt position is improving as visible in the presentation, we think we will be able to accelerate the payment of the acquisition debt.

items.quote: So most of our price increases right now have been only to pass on whatever cost increases we have experienced. items.quote: By the end of Q2 I think we should have clarity on the quantification of this. As of now, we cannot provide anything more than that because the numbers are quite fluid, so by next quarter, we will be able to provide some more color.

items.quote: what has changed in our product mix, azo is good but I think high performance has grown substantially and our pigment dispersion business has grown substantially and that those categories then become more important.

items.quote: We expect the things to normalize from the current quarter onwards. We are confident that before the year end it will be posting a positive number that is the work that we are trying to do.

items.statement: Aspiration to reach 7x 2023 EBITDA and become debt-free; legacy Sudarshan targeting 12-13% growth
items.quote: What we aspire to be is really seven times of what our EBITDA was in 2023 and also reach a debt-free level and that is our aspiration going forward.

items.statement: Project Integra (One SAP) expected to go live this financial year, reducing complexity from 4 SAPs and 130 applications
items.quote: we have set up a very good interim MIS, and are moving towards an advanced One SAP project, we call it Project Integra and we expect to go live with our integrated system and reducing a lot of complexities in this financial year.

items.statement: UP Phase 2 distillery permissions applied for, firmer execution timeline expected in 3-4 months
items.quote: Phase 2, we'll -- I think sir, we'll -- we have applied for the permissions, because Phase 2 is about the distillery. I think we'll have more a firmer idea about the execution maybe three to four months down the line, sir.

items.statement: Raw material and packaging costs increased 7.5-8% YoY in Q1, no price hike taken
items.quote: No, sir, I think -- we have seen an increase in the price of cans, malt, bottles during the first quarter as compared to quarter one last year. Average increase has been about 7.5% to 8%.

items.statement: Beer 98.9% of volume and 93% of revenue; IMFL realization improved 3% YoY to INR1,047/case
items.quote: Beer represented approximately 98.9% of our total volume and 93% of our revenue. ... On the IMFL side, realization improved by approximately 3% year-on-year to INR1,047 per case.

items.statement: Generated INR28 crores operating cash flow in Q1 despite MP disruption
