items.quote: Food and Beverage remain an important part of our overall hospitality ecosystem, contributing approximately 43% of total revenue during the quarter.

items.statement: West Asia crisis and flat domestic air traffic pressured Q1 ADR; international air traffic into India declined ~10%
items.quote: International air traffic into India during this course of this quarter has declined by almost 10%.

items.statement: EM Bypass sales to generate Rs.300-325 crores over 4 years, funding hotel development; net debt/EBITDA at 0.70
items.quote: We expect to have sale of Rs. 300 crores to Rs. 325 crores which is our share in this mixed-use development. And the same amount of money is going to be used for the development of the hotel at EM Bypass.

items.statement: Portfolio to grow from 42 hotels (2,677 keys) to 3,149 keys by end FY27 via 12-hotel pipeline (472 keys); target 6,719 keys by 2030
items.quote: We now have a pipeline of 12 hotels comprising of 472 keys for this year. These additions are expected to take our portfolio from the current 42 hotels with 2,677 keys to 3,149 keys by the end of FY27.

items.statement: Malabar House acquisition in Fort Kochi (17 keys) expected to close Oct-Nov 2026 for Rs.64 crores
items.quote: The acquisition of the Malabar House in Fort Kochi is currently in progress. The property comprises of 17 keys on approximately half an acre of land and this acquisition is expected to be completed by October-November of 2026.

items.statement: Pune FSI increased from 2.5 lakh to 6.7 lakh sq ft; plan 2.5 lakh for hotel, 4+ lakh for residential development
items.quote: At Pune, the FSI available to us on our land has changed from 2.5 lakh square feet to 6.7 lakh square feet.

items.statement: Tax rate to drop from ~40% to 30-35% from Q2 FY27 under new tax regime, improving PAT
items.quote: Our tax rate from next quarter will go down from 35 to 25% as we are coming under new regime. So, this time it does have a 40% tax rate but in future in Q2, Q3, Q4 our tax rate is going to come down to around 30% to 35%.

items.statement: SAP S4 HANA Finance implementation completed to strengthen controls and reporting as portfolio scales
items.quote: During the quarter, we completed the implementation of SAP S4 HANA for Finance.

items.statement: Expects 20-25% revenue growth for FY27, already achieved 20% in Q1 without new product contribution
items.quote: 20% is something we were expecting, 20 -25% to happen in the entire year, but it is already translated and the other products have not even contributed.

items.statement: Strong domestic demand across all products; infrastructure and power push driving growth; export orders rejected due to full galvanizing capacity
items.quote: This year, market looks very good domestically as the global situation is very unpredictable. The freight charges are quite high. Most of the steel manufacturers are concentrating on their domestic sales, which is why we are seeing a lot of growth domestically.

items.statement: Galvanizing capacity is key bottleneck; all tanks full; rejecting hollow section, export, and 1161/3601 BIS orders; monopole certifications pending until Q3
items.quote: We are not able to take a lot of orders that come from export because again that will occupy our galvanizing. Most of the orders are galvanizing pipe. So, our galvanizing capacity in Bombay where we do our exports is already full.

items.statement: Q2 revenue growth ~30% YoY (20% base + 1,000t/month from TLT/crash barrier ~10 Cr/month); TLT dispatch 300-400t this month, poles targeting 300t/month by Oct
items.quote: In Q1, you've seen a 20% increase in turnover. In Q1? So, similarly, in Q2, you will see this 20%. Plus, apart from that, you will see growth on other subjects such as transmission line tower and crash barrier. So, those will also start reflecting. For example, we're expecting that we'll increase our sales by 1,000 ton

items.statement: Uniware expected to grow over 15% YoY from Q4 FY27 onwards
items.quote: As quarter 4 FY '27 will be the first full quarter of like-for-like comparison following this client exit, we are confident of delivering growth of over 15% from quarter 4 FY '27 onwards in Uniware.

items.statement: Shipway expected to grow 20%+ YoY from Q4 FY27 onwards
items.quote: With the investments that we are making, we are anticipating that this growth will improve to 20% plus from quarter 4 FY '27.

items.statement: Shipway targeted to reach adjusted EBITDA breakeven by Q3 FY27
items.quote: We are targeting to make Shipway breakeven in quarter 3 itself.

items.statement: Consolidated profitability improvement expected in H2 FY27 as front-loaded investments materialize
items.quote: Most of these investments will be front-loaded in H1 FY '27 with benefits expected to build through growth and operating leverage, leading to an improving profitability trajectory in H2 FY '27 and beyond.

items.statement: Investments of a few crores annually in AI product development, talent, and go-to-market expansion
items.quote: The investment in terms of absolute is in the range of a few crores and will continue for the current quarter, post which we anticipate some of these investments to start demonstrating results.

items.statement: Uniware standalone adjusted EBITDA margin improved from 32% to 35% run rate despite investments
items.quote: Uniware, even with investments, it has grown from 32% to 35% from an adjusted EBITDA run rate perspective.

items.statement: Uniware adjusted EBITDA margin expected to stay in 35-40% ballpark in H2 FY27
items.quote: Last year, it had gone to the 40% adjusted EBITDA margin levels as well. So it should stay in similar ballpark as we continue to see improvement in profitability in the second half of the year.

items.statement: Shipway to operate at breakeven level for next couple of years, reinvesting any profits
items.quote: We want to continue growing the business for the next couple of years, at least we want to operate it at a breakeven level.

items.statement: Added 115 enterprise customers in Q1 FY27, up 30.7% YoY
items.quote: During the quarter, we added 115 enterprise customers, up 30.7% compared to 88 in the same quarter last year.

items.statement: 40-45% of Uniware enterprise customers using quick commerce and B2B modules; UniReco at 6-7% attach rate; UniCapture at 3-4% attach rate
items.quote: 40% to 45% of our Uniware enterprise customers are now using quick commerce and B2B modules. 6% to 7% have adopted UniReco within a year of launch and 3% to 4% have taken up UniCapture within 2 quarters of its launch.

items.statement: Shipway operates in INR 4,000+ crore courier aggregation market with single-digit market share
items.quote: Shipway operates in courier aggregation, which is a large market opportunity. As per our estimates, it's INR4,000 crores plus market, where we are a relatively early-stage player, single-digit market share today.

items.statement: ESOP expense of INR 2.5-4 crores per quarter expected to continue for next year
items.quote: Over the period of next year, the spend would be trending in the similar range of INR2.5 crores to INR4 crores per quarter.

items.statement: Management guides for mid-teens revenue growth with stable EBITDA margins for the full year
items.quote: What we are guiding for is the business as a whole, which is for Belrise as a whole, which is mid-teens revenue growth with stable EBITDA margins.

items.statement: EBITDA margins expected to remain broadly stable at FY26 levels despite Q1 cost pressures
items.quote: We expect EBITDA margins to remain broadly stable as compared to FY26 levels.

items.statement: INR17,000 million QIP proceeds to be deployed primarily towards inorganic opportunities and select organic growth in FY27
items.quote: We intend to deploy a significant majority of these net proceeds within this fiscal year, primarily towards high-quality inorganic opportunities and also towards select organic growth initiatives.

items.statement: Renewable energy order for sheet metal assemblies supporting 2.5 GW annual supply, production starting Q4 FY27, peak revenue >INR1,500 million
items.quote: At peak volumes, the facility is expected to generate annual revenue in excess of INR1,500 million.

items.statement: Chassis system order for fast-growing 2W/3W OEM worth >INR650 million annual revenue, production starting Q4 FY27 at Bangalore brownfield
items.quote: The program is expected to generate annual revenue in excess of INR650 million and will be added to our existing brownfield facility in Bangalore, with start of production expected in Q4 of this fiscal year.

items.statement: 59 unique assemblies localization order for leading Indian 4W EV OEM, plus tooling/fixtures/automation design order
items.quote: We have been selected to manufacture 59 unique assemblies as part of their localization program for one of their highest-selling EV models.

items.statement: Aerospace & defense target: 10% of manufacturing revenue in short-to-medium term via acquisitions in Europe, North America, India
items.quote: Sumedh, already mentioned in the last earnings call that we want aerospace and defense to get to 10% of our manufacturing revenue in a short to medium term.

items.statement: Hyva India tipper business acquisition expected to close Q3 FY27; adds 3 manufacturing facilities (Pune, Jamshedpur, Bangalore)
items.quote: The transaction is currently progressing through the closing process and we expect to complete it during Q3 of this financial year.

items.statement: Input cost pressures (steel, polymer) peaked in Q1 FY27; back-to-back pricing model passes fluctuations to customers with slight lag
items.quote: I can say with a great amount of confidence that the worst is behind us in terms of cost pressures.

items.statement: Trading business declined 19% YoY due to Middle East crisis impacting logistics and demand; expected to normalize
items.quote: Due to the ongoing crisis in the Middle East, there was a lot of pressure in terms of business scenario in the Middle East over this quarter.

items.statement: H-One Japan technology collaboration concluded, enabling high tensile steel applications up to 1470 MPa (~3x India standard)
items.quote: We have also now successfully concluded our technology collaboration with H-One Japan during this quarter, thus strengthening our capabilities for high tensile steel applications up to 1470 megapascal, which is approximately 3x the industry standard today in India.

items.statement: Plasan Sasa partnership for armored vehicle assembly in India; Hyva heavy fabrication capabilities seen as synergistic
items.quote: We believe the heavy fabrication know-how, manufacturing processes, and capabilities that come with the Hyva business will be highly synergistic with this initiative and further strengthen our ability to address this massive opportunity.

items.statement: Industry price increases unsustainable due to weak demand and elevated Chinese supply; packaging costs 40% higher YoY
items.quote: Prices of several molecules remained under pressure as global supply remained elevated, particularly with continued availability of intermediates and technical products from China.

items.statement: Delayed monsoon caused delayed sowing, resowing, and cautious dealer stocking; Q1 demand shifted to subsequent quarters
items.quote: The delayed rainfall resulted in delayed sowing across several important agriculture markets. In certain regions, farmers had to reassess their crop plans or undertake resowing.

items.statement: 189 global registrations (120+ valid, 10+ under renewal); new registrations in Taiwan, Vietnam, Sri Lanka, Saudi Arabia; expanding in Africa, LatAm
items.quote: Overall, we have 189 registrations globally, of which more than 120 are valid and more than 10 are under renewal.

items.statement: El Nino declared; weak monsoon outlook for remainder of FY27; channel inventories low; raw material costs remain incrementally higher than last year
items.quote: We are not expecting very promising monsoons even in the coming days because this El Nino has already been declared.

items.statement: Two of three planned specialty products launched; new fungicide on track for Q2 launch subject to patent expiry; ICAR-IARI collaboration for heat/drought resistant products
items.quote: Two of the three speciality products planned for FY27 are already in the market, while our new fungicide remains on track for launch this quarter, subject to the relevant patent expiry.

items.statement: Expects LFL growth of 5-7% above passenger traffic in normalized years; targets LFL of 14-15% when passenger traffic grows 8-9%
items.quote: We've traditionally been where, we're used to passenger traffic somewhere around 8% to 9% in normal years, and drive maybe 5% to 7% more of LFL growth over that to kind of reach an LFL percentage maybe around 14% -15%.

items.statement: Expects strong H2 FY27 passenger traffic bounce-back as airlines restore long-haul international routes from September-October
items.quote: The expectation is H2 of this year should be a good bounce back on passenger traffic. And I think that's also been a call-out by many independent research, what they expect passenger traffic this year in India to be, a strong H2.

items.statement: Adjusted gross margin ~81% (within guided range); EBITDA margin 35.8% moderated due to pre-operating costs for new outlets at Noida, Cochin, Delhi
items.quote: Adjusting for this reclassification of INR223 million of lounge aggregation cost from other expenses to cost of sales, the adjusted gross profit stands at INR3.65 billion, translating into an adjusted gross profit margin of around 81%, which remains well within our guided range.

items.statement: Net contract gains of 15.9% system-wide YoY; historically in 15-16% ballpark but lumpy year-to-year
items.quote: We sustained strong momentum in new outlet openings, backed by recent contract wins and a robust pipeline, which translated into net contract gains of 15.9% year-on-year at the system-wide level.

items.statement: Launched passenger services (meet-and-greet, porter) at Noida under Elite Assist brand; integrating into EATS tech platform for cross-selling
items.quote: Another important milestone during the quarter was the successful launch of our passenger services at Noida International Airport under our Elite Assist brand, including meet-and-greet and porter services.

items.statement: Debt-free balance sheet with INR9.7B cash as of June 30; provides headroom for airport expansions, lounges, highways, passenger services
items.quote: As of June 30th, we maintain a debt-free balance sheet and a consolidated cash balance of approximately INR9.7 billion.

items.statement: International expansion focus shifting to Asia (Indonesia entity set up) while Middle East normalizes; Dubai entity established for Middle East opportunities
items.quote: We have set up an entity in Dubai to focus at the region. We set up another entity recently in Indonesia to look at opportunities there because you need those local entities to be able to bid for opportunities in the markets.

items.statement: Targeted turnover for FY27 is INR 850 crore and for FY28 is INR 1,200 crore
items.quote: Sir, targeted turnover for the FY26-27 is almost INR 850 crores and for FY27-28 is INR 1,200 crores.

items.statement: Total work order including recent toll wins is INR 900 crore (EPC ~INR 500 crore, toll ~INR 400 crore)
items.quote: Recently we secured INR 120 crores new toll projects in Tamil Nadu. And so, adding this, we have INR 900 crores of work order, out of which EPC is almost INR 500 crores and the rest for toll segment.

items.statement: Traffic trends improving and near normal levels after geopolitical disruptions impacted Moti Naroli toll plaza in Q1
items.quote: And you can also see it on the IHMCL website. So, naturally, we are almost near normal to what the earlier traffic was.

items.statement: EBITDA margin drop in Q1 due to geopolitical factors; recovery expected if no new developments
items.quote: Yes, I think so. And even so, I think there was a drop in our EBITDA margin recently because of this geopolitical situation recently. And so, going forward, I think, and if there are no new developments on that front, we should be good.

items.statement: Voluntary surrender of a toll project with unfavorable economics due to geopolitical disruptions
items.quote: A temporary bidding restriction from NHAI and the voluntary surrender of a toll project where economics had been unfavorable due to the same reason.

items.statement: Current weakness from geopolitical factors will not significantly impact full-year results; recovery in H2 as per seasonal trend
items.quote: Actually, this won't have a significant impact on the full-year results because, based on past trends, we tend to hover around the break-even point during the first and second quarters, while seeing a rapid recovery in the third and fourth quarters.

items.statement: FY27 maize crushing target above 400,000 tons vs 265,000 tons in FY26
items.quote: This year, we are expecting that the crushing will go up above 4,00,000 tons in the entire year.

items.statement: Value-added products expected to reach 20-22% of turnover in FY27 from 3% in FY26
items.quote: This year, we are expecting it to go up to 20 %-22% of our entire turnover as value -added products.

items.statement: Major capex cycle substantially complete; Rs 552 crore spent of Rs 664 crore total outlay by June 2026
items.quote: Of the total project outlay of approximately Rs. 664 crores, around Rs. 552 crores had been incurred as of 30 June 2026, with the major phase of CAPEX cycle now substantially behind us.

items.statement: Value-added margin expanded to 39.8% in Q1 FY27 from 25.1% in Q1 FY26 driven by shift to manufacturing-led revenue
items.quote: Value-added grew 30.3% year -on-year to Rs. 80.53 crores, with value -added margin expanded to 39.8% from 25.1% in Q1 FY26 , driven by a decisive shift towards higher margin, manufacturing led revenue.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expanded 540 bps to 15.3% in Q1 FY27; PAT margin improved 291 bps to 6.6%
items.quote: The operating EBITDA rose 26.6% year -on-year to Rs . 30.98 crores, with EBITDA margin expanding 540 basis points to 15.3%. The profit after tax grew 47% year -on-year to Rs. 13.33 crores and PAT margin improved 291 basis points to 6.6%.

items.statement: Export contribution doubled to 10.4% in Q1 FY27 from 4.9% in Q1 FY26; targeting further geographic diversification
items.quote: Contribution from exports more than doubled to 10.4% in quarter 1 '27 from 4.9% in quarter 1 '26, reflecting growing acceptance of our products across international markets.

items.statement: New value-added products include Liquid Glucose (180 TPD), Maltodextrin (50 TPD); Modified starches and Dextrose variants planned for FY27
items.quote: During FY'27, we plan to enter high value derivatives including Dextrose Anhydrous, Dextrose Monohydrate and Hydrol , while expanding beyond our existing Dextrin and edible starch range into specialized modified starches such as cationic starch, carboxy methyl starch, pre-gel starch and spray starch.

items.statement: Net debt Rs 735.32 crore; peak debt in H1 FY27, expected to decline in H2 as working capital normalizes
items.quote: Our working capital requirement is highest in the H1. So, that's why the debt is peaking. And definitely, it is going to come down when the H2 comes.

items.statement: Long-term value-added capacity mix designed at 50:50 starch:value-added; FY28 turnover mix guided at 30-35% value-added
items.quote: Capacity, so automatically 35% will happen. Turnover automatically 30%-35%. Total turnover.

items.statement: Target to cross INR500 crores consolidated revenue in FY27 with 12-15% growth
items.quote: We continue to work towards our stated objective of crossing INR500 crores in consolidated revenue during the FY 27, while maintaining appropriate discipline on margins and working capital.

items.statement: Received Reliance Group orders worth INR45.71 crores, Nesco INR1.94 crores, West Bengal Secretariat INR36.71 lakhs in Q1 FY27
items.quote: We received 5 work orders from Reliance Projects and Property Management Services worth INR30.77 crores for housekeeping, MEP electrical, and ancillary services. In addition, we secured facility management contracts across 7 Reliance Group entities valued at INR14.94 crores, taking the combined value of orders from the

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded 121 bps to 7.99%; management expects 1-2% EBITDA margin improvement over next 2 years from technology mix shift
items.quote: I would expect at least an increase of about 1% to 2% in the EBITDA area over the next 2 years or so.

items.statement: Wage hikes passed to clients with 3-month DSO lag; temporary working capital impact
items.quote: Yes, so we of course give the wages first and then we raise a bill on the client and then the client pays typically in three months. That is our DSO cycle.

items.statement: INR1 crore investment for HDFC command center setup; skill development centers require capex for labs and training infrastructure
items.quote: The investment, currently the investment that we are looking at is around a INR1 crores to set up the entire control room, wooden wall panels, et cetera.

items.statement: IPO proceeds balance INR36.85 crores as of June 2026; no buyback planned, funds earmarked for growth, skill development capex, working capital
items.quote: Yes so currently as on June 2026 IPO funds which are available is around INR36.85 crores.

items.statement: GeM bidding at 3.85% margin compresses government manpower contracts; CCTV segment loss in Q1 due to project execution timing
items.quote: Government contracts, you are aware in terms of the GeM bidding, nowadays they have brought down the percentage to 3.85%. So at L1 everybody is bidding at 3.85%.

items.statement: Net debt: standalone INR69 crores, consolidated INR82 crores; cash INR60 crores (standalone June); working capital ~90 days; client retention 96-97%
items.quote: At a standalone basis, it is around INR69 crores and on a consolidated basis it is around INR82 crores.

items.statement: Long-term revenue target of INR600-700 crores in 2-3 years with healthier profitability
items.quote: I believe that INR600 crores to INR700 crores figure long-term revenue targets are still in place.

items.statement: Expect meaningful improvement in returns from strategic investments in 3-6 quarters
items.quote: So, the answer would be in 3 quarters to 6 quarters I think we can start seeing results of these strategic investments.

items.statement: Consolidated PAT declined to INR2.2 crores from INR6.51 crores YoY due to higher freight and employee costs
items.quote: On a consolidated basis, PBT stood at INR3.04 crores compared with INR7.26 crores, and PAT stood at INR2.2 crores compared with INR6.51 crores.

items.statement: Shipping costs increased significantly; company absorbing partial hit while passing some to purchase and sales prices
items.quote: We are taking the hit, but we are still able to grow on revenue. We are taking partial hit and we are taking -- where we are partially trying to supply, like, pass it on to the suppliers also, like, at the time of purchase, and partially trying to pass it at the time of sales.

items.statement: No fixed capex; investments in inventory, manpower, and marketing are transient and growing quarter-on-quarter
items.quote: All the investments made are transient in nature. None of them are fixed investments or any plant machinery capex purchases, etcetera, which has a certain timeline of 3-year break even or whatever.

items.statement: Inventory conversion cycle runs over 2 quarters; INR96.8 crores consolidated inventory as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: As of June 30, 2026, our consolidated inventory stood at about INR96.8 crores, with around INR84.4 crores positioned at our overseas subsidiaries.

items.statement: Target equal revenue mix across new customized equipment, used/refurbished equipment, and HexL in 2-3 years
items.quote: I think if all the three verticals are equal in our revenue mix, I think we would be happy enough.

items.statement: Geopolitical developments increasing freight/logistics costs and elongating shipping times and working capital cycles
items.quote: The ongoing geopolitical developments across various regions have continued to create operational and logistical challenges, particularly for the businesses with significant international exposure, such as ours.

items.statement: Employee benefit expenses rose to INR3.83 crores from INR2.21 crores YoY to build international sales and operations team
items.quote: Consolidated employee benefit expenses increased to approximately INR3.83 crores from INR2.21 crores in the corresponding period last year.

items.statement: Full-year revenue growth guidance revised up from 50% to 70% YoY for FY27, with potential to trail higher in coming quarters
items.quote: So, we would like to revise our guidance for the full year to 70% considering the robust demand which is there and the capacities that we are ready with in Ratlam. And we would like to also highlight one thing that we can trail this guidance in the coming quarters as the year progress.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance maintained at sustainable to improve from current 18.9% level for FY27
items.quote: So, I'd like to reiterate that point only. So, we will continue our margin guidance from sustainable to improve for the year. So, we have reported a 18.9% margin, so we continue that guidance.

items.statement: Cumulative gross block including CWIP expected to reach Rs 1,300 crore by end of FY27 from Rs 800 crore at start of year
items.quote: On the capex front, ma'am. When we start this year, we were close to 800 including CWIP and we are by the end of this year, it will be close to 1.300.

items.statement: Channel partner network expanded to 10,100+ (80+ distributors, 1,000+ dealers, 30+ exclusive Shoppes added in Q1); target 15,000+ by end of FY28
items.quote: At the end of 28, we believe more than 15,000 Network partaers including Shoppe? Including Shoppe, dealer and distributor, 15,000.

items.statement: FY27 revenue guidance and PAT margin of 5-6% reaffirmed
items.quote: We remain aligned with the FY27 revenue guidance and PAT margin in the range of 5% to 6%.

items.statement: Order book visibility at INR3,400 crore across confirmed POs, signed MSAs, and advanced discussions
items.quote: On order book visibility, currently stands at approximately INR3,400 crore.

items.statement: Executable order pipeline of INR845.84 crore targeted for execution by December 31, 2026
items.quote: Together, these orders represent an executable order pipeline of INR845.84 crore targeted for the execution by the December 31st, 2026.

items.statement: Cell line capex revised to INR1,050 crore (INR700 crore debt, INR350 crore equity) for 2.2 GW first phase
items.quote: At present, INR1,050 crore, out of which INR700 crore from the principal lenders and INR350 crore will be our margin.

items.statement: 2.2 GW N-type TOPCon+ cell line on track for commissioning by end of calendar year 2027
items.quote: The 2.2 GW N-type TOPCon+ cell line, which is the first phase of our planned 5 GW cell capacity, is on track for commissioning by end of calendar year 2027.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 12.7% vs 16.4% YoY; PAT margin 3.1% due to seasonally softer volumes and full quarter depreciation/interest impact
items.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR33.8 crore as against the INR42.7 crore in Q1 FY26, translating into an EBITDA margin of 12.7% for the quarter as compared to 16.4% in Q1 FY26.

items.statement: H2-weighted execution expected; order conversions accelerating post-monsoon with ALMM clarity
items.quote: The situation will be improved once the monsoon gets over and then there will be a lot of pressure in execution of projects and delivery of modules for both the segments.

items.statement: FY27 module utilization assumption 55% (down from ~70% in FY26) due to industry disruption and cell supply constraints
items.quote: For FY27, we are working with an average utilization assumption of around 55% across the year.

items.statement: ALMM-2 caused temporary delivery rescheduling but no order cancellations; domestic cell supply arrangements in place for DCR orders
items.quote: These are the timing shifts and not cancellations. We do not currently see any orders at risk and whether ALMM is extended at any stage or not, there is no impact on our order book.

items.statement: Cell line funding: INR700 crore debt at advanced stage, INR350 crore equity (NCDs/CCDs) in due diligence
items.quote: On funding, the debt component of approximately INR700 crore is at an advanced stage of discussion with our lender, and the equity component of INR350 crore structured as a combination of NCDs and CCDs is progressing through the due diligence stage.

items.statement: BSE listing completed (existing shares, no fresh capital); shareholder base 11,000+
items.quote: Solex Energy is now listed on both the NSE and the BSE. Kindly note, this was a listing of existing shares on the BSE main board. No fresh capital was raised.

items.statement: Indian TOPCon cell cost higher than imported Chinese cells; DCR tenders priced accordingly
items.quote: Those tenders which are already bidded with the domestic cells are bidded with the higher price considering the high cost of cell. The Indian cell cost will be higher compared to the imported right now.

items.statement: Vision 2030: 10 GW module, 10 GW cell, 10 GW BESS, 2 GW wafer/ingot; INR4,000 crore Gujarat MoU signed
items.quote: The INR4,000 crore MoU we have signed with the Government of Gujarat is the first concrete step in that direction.

items.statement: Management expects sustainable good earnings for next 6 to 8 quarters on favorable BOPET supply-demand.
items.quote: So , all this give us confidence that we should have sustainable good earnings going forward, not only for the next 3 quarters, but I would go on to say, for next 6 to 8 quarters.

items.statement: Company expects to reach INR2,000-2,200 crore revenue in next 2-3 years.
items.quote: Yes. I think we are steadily marching towards that, and we should definitely be hitting there in next 2 years to 3 years.

items.statement: Targeting VAS products at 50-60% of film volumes over next 2-3 years.
items.quote: Encouraged by the recent performance and positive outcomes of our strategic focus, we are targeting proportion of VAS products at about 50% to 60% over the next 2 to 3 years.

items.statement: VAS contribution expected up to 35% of portfolio by exit quarter this fiscal.
items.quote: See, we are seeing up to 35% contribution of VAS product out of our own -- up to the overall portfolio by the quarter end, I mean, in the exit quarter.

items.statement: Specialty Polymers targeting 20% CAGR over next 3-5 years; FY27 flat to single-digit growth.
items.quote: We are targeting growth at a CAGR of 20% over the next 3 to 5 years in the Specialty Polymer segment.

items.statement: Specialty Polymers revenue growth expected to recover by end of this financial year.
items.quote: However, given the strength of our business development pipeline, we expect to recover the revenue growth in this business by the end of this financial year.

items.statement: Specialty Polymers EBIT margin may moderate in percentage terms but absolute EBITDA/EBIT to grow.
items.quote: But you are right. As we go forward, we are g oing to see some moderation of the percentage margins, right? Because the mid-margin is going to pull down the high specialty margins a little bit in percentage terms.

items.statement: 12-micron commodity film spreads were INR28-30 last quarter and are holding resilient.
items.quote: So, spreads last quarter were in the range of INR28 to INR30. When I say spread, I mean VA, value-add over raw material for 12-micron film.

items.statement: BOPET supply-demand balance expected to hold for next 6-8 quarters, keeping margins steady.
items.quote: See, like I told you that we are very positive that for next 6 quarters to 8 quarters, the global and domestic supply-demand balance is going to hold. And I think that is going to give us some respite and is going to keep the margin steady.

items.statement: Only 2-3 new BOPET lines expected in next 1.5-2 years; demand growth outpacing capacity.
items.quote: We are expecting another 2 to 3 lines coming up in the next 1.5 to 2 years.

items.statement: No major capex planned apart from sustenance and maintenance capex.
items.quote: No. So, apart from our sustenance and maintenance capex, we are not planning any major capex.

items.statement: Debt repayment target of INR100 crores this year; gross debt to fall to INR620 crores.

items.statement: Calibrated price increases in edible oils; targeted discounts and smaller pack sizes in FMCG to remain competitive

items.quote: It was generating a margin of INR600 crores, and we have paid INR1,100 crores which is less than 18, 19 months of profitability and which has already in last 18 months it has already repaid that much and built up assets substantially.

items.statement: Revenue guidance of Rs 300 crore for FY27 reaffirmed; Q1 FY27 revenue at Rs 60.95 crore, balance order book of Rs 150 crore to be executed this year plus pipeline orders by March
items.quote: Sir we have done already 60 in Q1. And the balance about 150 crores, the order book that also needs to be finished in this financial year. And definitely there are some orders in pipeline which also we would need to do it by March. So 300 we are in line Sir.
