items.statement: Secured MSME yield 32.48%, vehicle 19.87%, wholesale ~16%, personal/business loans 14-15%.
items.quote: The yield on the secured MSME business is 32.48%. This is based on the June closing. The vehicle segment generates a yield of 19.87%, wholesale lending is around 16%, and personal and business loans generate approximately 14–15%.

items.statement: Upmoney exposure of Rs 18-19 crore; 70% provided, remaining 30% may be provided if no recovery.
items.quote: Regarding Upmoney, we had an approximately ₹18–19 crore book exposure. We are working toward a resolution.

items.statement: Gross NPA 2.08% including Upmoney, 0.83% excluding it.
items.quote: Including Upmoney, gross NPA is 2.08%. Excluding Upmoney, it is 0.83%, which is bel ow 1%.

items.statement: Main AUM growth to come from MSME; vehicle finance limited to select branches/states.
items.quote: The main growth will come from MSME because our main product is MSME. We are present across six states and have 196 branches.

items.statement: MSME and SME loans together are about 80-82% of the business.
items.quote: Today, MSME and SME loans together account for approximately 80–82% of our business.

items.statement: Exploring digital personal loans and a documented-income secured MSME product; gold loans and supply-chain finance on hold.
items.quote: We are also exploring some new products. For personal loans, we want to move the complete journey to a digital method.

items.statement: Will pass on any lender rate benefits to customers, which would also increase business.
items.quote: If we receive any benefit in terms of rates from lenders, we will definitely pass on some of that benefit to customers, which will also increase our business.

items.statement: No co-lending arrangement today; plans to enter co-lending in future; net leverage about 2%.
items.quote: As of today, we do not have any co -lending arrangement or co -lending agreement with any bank. However, we have a plan to enter the co-lending business in the future.

items.statement: Branch break-even in 7-9 months at AUM of Rs 1.5-2 crore; monthly branch expense Rs 1.5-2 lakh.
items.quote: In terms of branch economics, a typical branch reaches break-even in approximately 7–9 months when its AUM reaches around ₹1.5–2 crore.

items.statement: Expects FY27 revenue growth of at least 60-70% and profitability growth over 70-80%.
items.quote: Our expectation is that revenue will grow at least 60 to 70% , or even more than that, and profitability will also be growing more than 70 to 80%.

items.statement: Order book rose to 660 crore after adding 60 crore of fresh bookings, mainly international.
items.quote: If you recall the Q4 presentation, the order book was 600 crore, we are now showcasing an order book of 660 crore.

items.statement: About 410 crore of order book remains to be executed.
items.quote: We then added 60 crore more as fresh booking, which takes our order book to 660 crore, and a total of close to 410 crore still remains to be executed.

items.statement: ARR targeted at 180-200 crore by end of FY27, possibly higher.
items.quote: By the end of FY27 our idea is to be between 180 and 200 crore, because the more international deals we do, the more the ARR increases.

items.statement: Own IP platform revenue expected to start earlier than committed, from this or next month.
items.quote: We are expecting some revenue to start from this month or next month itself. We are eyeing some deals and we are on the verge of signing agreements and closing two deals, so we will start much earlier than what we had committed.

items.statement: Uptick in both margin and revenue expected, driven by international deals and AI infrastructure.
items.quote: Yes, an uptick in both margin and revenue is expected.

items.statement: Significant investment made in building AI-ready infrastructure practice over last two months.
items.quote: We have therefore invested significantly over the last two months in building an AI-ready infrastructure practice.

items.statement: CX-as-a-service and AI-as-a-service market growing 35-40%; company eyeing this.
items.quote: In terms of industry outlook, if you look at CX as a service and AI as a service, the combination shows very good growth, almost 35 to 40%, and that is the market we are eyeing.

items.statement: Cloud ERP growing at close to 20% CAGR; good pipeline and closures expected.
items.quote: Cloud ERP is again growing at close to 20% CAGR, and we are making good investments on this side.

items.statement: Added four or five large customers in Q1; on track with customer addition growth plan.
items.quote: In terms of our 150 -plus customers, in this p articular quarter we have added some four or five large customers , and some more additions on the smaller customer side.

items.statement: Planning to create five verticals in subsequent quarters including AI infrastructure and application-as-a-service.
items.quote: We will create five verticals in subsequent quarters. One will be AI infrastructure . The second will be application as a service , where probably our acquisition, or our Cloud ERP and some of the applications, will be integrated.

items.statement: UK growth from Agentic AI and services deals expected to continue; consolidating Europe.
items.quote: This will continue for the rest of the year. In fact, we are not looking at the UK alon e; we are consolidating Europe as well and we are looking at the entire international market.

items.statement: Expects 25-30% of FY27 business from AI infrastructure vertical.
items.quote: In FY27 we are expecting that close to 25 to 30% of contribution should come from this vertical.

items.statement: AI infrastructure initial margins 10-12%, expected to increase with land and expand.
items.quote: So typically, where we see it starting, and Murali and Gopi may correct me if I am wrong, would be in the range of 10 to 12%, but as we land and expand this is going to increase.

items.statement: Order book 660 crore; 251 crore executed, 410 crore unexecuted.
items.quote: We executed another 30 crore worth of orders in Q1, which takes the total execution to 251 crore, and the total value of the unexecuted order book to around 410 crore.

items.statement: Added 150-180 crore to order book since last year.
items.quote: Since last year we have added 150 crore. That is again a rough idea as I see it; it would be between 150 and 180 crore since last year.

items.statement: New AI infrastructure contracts: 60-70% one-time, 30-40% recurring revenue.
items.quote: So, you can understand that probably 60 to 70% would be one -time revenue and 30 to 40% would be recurring revenue as well.

items.statement: TAM for Exato currently $500-600 million, growing at 18-20% CAGR.
items.quote: As of now it is 500 to 600 million dollars, and it is expected to grow at 18 to 20% CAGR.

items.statement: Top five clients contribute ~60% of revenue; non-cancellable contracts mitigate risk.
items.quote: The top five clients would be contributing close to 60% of revenue.

items.statement: Client retention rate 97-98%, no client deflections in 5-6 years.
items.quote: It is 97 to 98%. We have not seen any client deflecting from us in the last five to six years .

items.statement: M&A may be funded by cash or fundraise; prefers equity stake by target company.
items.quote: It will depend on what the other party wants, but it could be a mix of the two. That is what we are expecting.

items.statement: Aiming for 1,000 crore revenue earlier than three years.
items.quote: Luis, I want to do it earlier than that. That is a wish list, obviously , and a lot of things will depend on how things shape up.

items.statement: Targeting 400-500 customer base.
items.quote: The base I want to build is having a 400 to 500 customer base.

items.statement: AI infrastructure will have relatively lower margin; AI as a service and CX better margins.
items.quote: But yes, AI infrastructure will have a relatively lower margin, while AI as a service and CX as a service will have the better margins.

items.statement: By 2030, CX as a service market to be $30 billion.
items.quote: By 2030 this will be a 30 billion dollar market altogether, which will include OEMs, consulting service providers and others.

items.statement: Aims to maintain 20% CAGR growth over next two years from FY25 base.
items.quote: we gave a guidance of over a 20% CAGR growth then for the we mentioned that we would aspire to grow at 20% CAGR over the next two, three years.

items.statement: Targets rolling mill utilization above 60% for FY27.
items.quote: we are still maintaining our guidance of what we have spoken earlier of achieving the utilization in excess of 60% for the rolling mill, as far as the rolling mill utilization is concerned for this, for this financial year.

items.statement: Aspires to improve EBITDA margin by 2-3% over two years.
items.quote: I think there should be a maybe a 2% to 3% improvement overall going forward. That is what we are looking at.

items.statement: Plans to integrate 40-50% of TMT production with melting shop to improve margins.
items.quote: if I aspire to let's say make let's say, just as an example 100 tons, I would like out of the 100 tons around 40 tons to 50 tons to be integrated.

items.statement: Hopeful of maintaining Q1 volume momentum despite monsoon season.
items.quote: we are hopeful of maintaining a steady momentum going forward.

items.statement: Focus on margin-accretive products, with 80-90% in 200 series stainless steel.
items.quote: almost 80% to 90% of my product range today is a grade called 200 series, wherein we are quite comfortable because it is not dependent on very high prices or very high fluctuative prices of critical alloys like nickel and moly.

items.statement: Stainless steel volumes declined 10-12% YoY due to geopolitical disruptions and high ocean freight.
items.quote: my stainless-steel volumes was a little softer as compared to Q1 ‘26. Just to give you a broad idea, I think we did about 9,000, approximately it was soft to the extent of approximately around 10% or so, 10% to 12% as compared to corresponding figures of last year.

items.statement: Plans to refinance existing debt to lower borrowing costs and enhance working capital limits.
items.quote: we are also looking at sort of a refinancing options with our existing lenders to bring down the cost of borrowing to a reasonable level.

items.statement: Maintains forward order visibility of about one month in stainless steel business.
items.quote: Forward visibility is in the range of about a month's, like a, like a month's orders that we like to ideally keep in hand every time.

items.statement: Credit period offered to customers is 30-40 days on average.
items.quote: the credit period in the range of 30 days to 40 days maximum on an average.

items.statement: Rooftop solar initiative not finalized; assessing feasibility and viability.
items.quote: we are still in talks with the suppliers. We are still wanting to assess the sort of the complete feasibility, viability, and the results of rooftop solar being operated in steel plants which are similar to us.

items.statement: Renewable power consumption around 20% of total, with flexibility to adjust based on pricing.
items.quote: the renewable total consumption of renewable power should be in the range of around 20%.

items.statement: TMT direct charging trial runs completed; full-scale operations expected by Q4 FY27.
items.quote: on a full throttle basis, I would expect sort of that to pick up, to be picked up by Q4.

items.statement: Management expects 10-15% quarter-on-quarter growth in revenue and PAT in coming quarters.
items.quote: So, in terms of percentage, we will increase our revenue and PAT by, say, quarter -on-quarter 10% to 15%.

items.statement: Revenue, EBITDA, and PAT will grow quarter-on-quarter, though revenue may fluctuate with LPG prices.
items.quote: Definitely, the revenue and the EBITDA and PAT will grow quarter-on-quarter. But as already mentioned by Prachi that revenue growth is due to increase in the price of LPG. So, as per the price of LPG, revenue might be fluctuating, but the growth will be there.

items.statement: Auto LPG stations to increase from 315 to 500, adding 75 in FY27 and 100 in FY28.
items.quote: We are targeting to complete 500 stations, 75 by 2026-2027, and then further 100 stations in 2027-2028, and then company will evaluate and further add up to 500 stations.

items.statement: CNG stations to increase by 50 in Bengaluru, from current 50+ to 100.
items.quote: In the CNG segment, we are already having 50 plus stations, which we are going to gradually increase further 50 in the city of Bengaluru, and further into talks with other CGD players for other locations.

items.statement: Type 4 high-pressure cylinder plant at Butibori is capex-complete; operations to start once order book is finalized.
items.quote: So, the capex is already completed for Type 4 cylinder manufacturing unit, which is coming up in Butibori. All the machineries are installed and everything is on the place. We are waiting for the order book to get start, and soon the plant will get operational.

items.statement: Margins are intact and increasing; percentage PAT decline is due to higher LPG prices inflating revenue.
items.quote: But actually, the profit margins are not declined. They are intact and they are increasing day-by-day. Our focus and management focuses on increasing the margin.

items.statement: Margins to increase once LPG prices normalize; volume growth to drive fixed-cost benefits.
items.quote: When the price get regularized, normalized, that time you will see the increase in the percentage of PAT, because the margins are intact, there is no fall in the margins.

items.statement: Q1 growth was volume-led with new bulk and institutional customers under short-to-medium term supply arrangements.
items.quote: Most importantly, a meaningful part of our Q1 performance was volume -led rather than purely price-led. We have secured a number of new bulk and institutional customers under short - to medium-term supply arrangements, providing us with greater revenue visib ility and a stronger base for sustained volume growth in the

items.statement: Auto LPG volumes recovering after temporary slowdown due to higher LPG prices.
items.quote: As market conditions have started stabilizing, Auto LPG volumes across our ALDS network are recovered. We are seeing a steady improvement , supported by focused marketing initiatives, customer outreach, and continued expansion of the network.

items.statement: Higher LPG prices increased reported revenue but margins remained broadly intact via disciplined pricing.
items.quote: Despite the elevated LPG prices and the corresponding increase in revenue, our margins remained broadly intact, reflecting disciplined pricing and efficient business operations.

items.statement: Income tax search from Oct 2025 closed; assessment pending, no large tax liability expected.
items.quote: The assessment is yet not closed, and we have not received any final tax amount from the department. And we have evaluated ourselves as well, so we don't se e any challenges to get it close, and we don't see any big amount to be payable for tax in coming future for this search.

items.statement: Promoters gradually increasing stake from open market, confident in LPG-focused business.
items.quote: Definitely, promoter is having a faith in the company because they are involved in the only business, LPG, which is Confidence Petroleum India Limited, and they are more focused in the same business. So, they are increasing their stake gradually.

items.statement: Company evaluating backward integration including small coastal storage terminals, not yet finalized.
items.quote: So, we are looking forward to establish a small storage terminals as well at different coastal areas, which are under talk, but yet not finalized.

items.statement: Expects 10-15% revenue growth in FY27 from existing order book, plus some contribution from new projects.
items.quote: 127, we are looking at a growth of 10%, 15% from the initial last year.

items.statement: Targets FY27 revenue execution of INR300-350 crores, with monthly run-rate of INR30-40 crores.
items.quote: Around another INR350 crores -- INR300 crores, INR350 crores, I think we can achieve. I just every month, we are doing now INR30 crores, INR4O crores. So, e can achieve INR300 crores to INR350 crores.

items.statement: Expects to maintain similar ~17% EBITDA margins, with potential improvement on larger projects.
items.quote: So for the quarter one, the EBITDA margin is 17%, approximately 17%. And we are looking to ‘maintain the margins.

items.statement: Confident current margins are sustainable for the next couple of years.
items.quote: Yes. We're confident that this margin are sustainable for the next couple of years.

items.statement: Current order book ~INR700 crores; plans to add at least INR500 crores within 3-6 months.
items.quote: Right now, the current order book is around INR700 crores, and we at least like plan to add another INRS00 crores in 6 months, 3 months or maybe before the year-end.

items.statement: Targets order book of INR1,200-1,500 crores, aiming for 3x turnover coverage.
items.quote: We always believe that we should have at least 3 the turnover -- 3x order book of the turnover. So we are targeting to at least achieve an order book of 1200 -- 1000, 1200, at least within the next three quarters.

items.statement: Next milestone is INR1,500 crores order book by end of financial year.
items.quote: The next milestone is INR1,500 crores, which we are targeting to maybe end of the year, financial year, we have an order book of INR1,500 crores, which the next target is.

items.statement: Has bid four tenders worth ~INR800 crores awaiting opening; expects 1-2 to materialize.
items.quote: So already, we have bidded four tenders, around INR80O crores tenders are already in line of opening. So we are expecting at least one or two orders to materialize...

items.statement: Sees large opportunity in Delhi from new master plan; government infrastructure spending remains supportive.
items.quote: The confidence we have is the projects coming up are - we have a lot of projects are coming up for central government, which we are focused with new master plan being approved in Delhi, there is going to be a big opportunity of number of works that are going to come up in Delhi only.

items.statement: Focus on institutional/education segment (IITs, IIMs, NITs) as main revenue driver; also betting on sports infrastructure.
items.quote: The institutional business, the education is our main focus and with the IITs, IIMs, NITs, we have -- that's giving us a major revenue in terms of turover.

items.statement: Top 5 projects contribute ~70% of turnover; 11-12 projects running simultaneously.
items.quote: So if you see, we only have 11 or 12 projects, on top 5, I think, contributes to the 70% of the turnover because I mean remaining 5 would be smaller or towards the end of the project.

items.statement: Selective bidding to maintain margins; central government projects preferred for better fund availability and faster rotation.
items.quote: So we do a selective bidding 50 that we get a better profit margin, better EBITDA. So that's the key factor, and that's what we are continuing to do.

items.statement: Trade receivables elevated due to pending final bills on three completed projects; expects Aligarh billing by Sept 15.
items.quote: Receivable days are a little high nowadays because final bills are still pending in our three projects like NBCC Aligarh project and Telecomnunications India Limited, two projects we have completed, but the funds are - final bill and final approval, all things are pending.

items.statement: Can achieve INR500-600 crores turnover with existing setup without increasing fixed costs.
items.quote: Yes, with this setup, we can achieve a turnover of INR500 crores to INR600 crores easily. We have a setup.

items.statement: Targeting 8-10 new stores in FY27 with expected revenue of INR1 crore per month per new store
items.quote: We are expecting almost further stores, almost 8 to 10 stores by fiscal '27, and the revenue from these new stores will be in the range of INR1 crores per month.

items.statement: Q1 EBITDA margin declined 133 bps YoY to 6.3% due to manufacturing/export mix and raw material volatility; expected to recover
items.quote: Actually, the decline of 133 basis points was primarily due to mix of manufacturing, export, and commodity-linked business, which had a higher raw material intensity during the Q1.

items.statement: Processing facility utilization at 50-55%, targeting 80-82% by end of FY27-FY28
items.quote: Right. So, the current utilization is between 50% to 55%, but in the medium term by the end of FY27, FY28, we plan on getting this utilization to around 80%, 80%, 82%.

items.statement: Online sales limited (INR50 lakhs in Q1) due to touch-and-feel consumer behavior in Tier-2/3/4 cities; focusing on society activations and quick commerce trials
items.quote: the location where we operate right now, right, mainly Tier-3, Tier-4 cities and Tier-2 cities. The online trend in certain categories where we have our USP, let's say, like a staple category, which contributes to more than like a 50% of our revenue, comes is still a very touch and feel category, right?

items.statement: Indian Chaska brand expanded to Madhya Pradesh (8 states + 1 UT), averaging INR10-12 lakhs/month; planning whole spices and protein categories
items.quote: Madhya Pradesh, as of now, we are averaging at INR10 lakh to INR12 lakh per month which isn't bad because spices category is such where the consumer loyalty is very high. In fact, this number gives us confidence that Madhya Pradesh is a very potent ial area where Indian Chaska acceptance would be much faster

items.statement: Retail wastage under 0.1%; manufacturing uses full 360-degree processing with minimal waste
items.quote: Yes, it is it is less than 0.1%, and in manufacturing and processing, except for the sand that comes when we procure from our farmers, right, nothing really goes t o wastage. It is a full 360 kind of processing facilities where we try to provide value to every aspect, every byproduct that is that comes with the main co

items.statement: Five-year focus on Western suburbs and Pune PCMC expansion via cluster strategy; priority on steady profitability with volume and capital discipline
items.quote: Right. So in the next five years, we in terms of our retail store footprints, we would try we will try to enter the Western suburbans as well as Pune PCMC regi on once the cluster is been identified. With that being said, I wouldn't segregate the contribution from each of the sectors. Our focus would be on steady profi

items.statement: Revenue growth guidance of 20-25% for FY27
items.quote: We expect to grow in the range of 20% to 25%.

items.statement: Order book at INR1,780 crores, up 30% since March 2026 and 195% since June 2025
items.quote: Our order book for machines, as of the end of the quarter, stood at approximately INR1,780 crores, up 30% since March '26 and up 195% since June '25.

items.statement: EBITDA margin of 19.9% in Q1 FY27, targeting 20% as new normal
items.quote: EBITDA margins stood at 19.9% compared with 11.5% in the same period last year.

items.statement: Management believes 20% EBITDA margin is sustainable going forward
items.quote: We believe that this is going to be the new normal for us.

items.statement: Current capacity sufficient for INR2,400-2,500 crores revenue; major capex not immediately planned
items.quote: The current capacities are good to take us to a revenue of around INR2,400, INR2,500. And beyond that, we would require some major capex, which we believe is yet to, you know, we have yet not started any plans around that.

items.statement: Order book driven by domestic capacity expansion; replacement cycle currently 3-5% but expected to increase
items.quote: Currently, I would believe that the order book would have around between 3% to 5% coming from replacement cycles. But majority is coming from the new expansions that our customers are building.

items.statement: Export prices 12-15% higher than domestic; command 15-20% premium over Chinese competitors
items.quote: As far as our offerings are concerned, we demand, we command, let's say, 15% to 20% higher prices than Chinese currently.

items.statement: Launched CoEx 1600 multi-layer coating line, Nova 6 Plus high-speed circular loom, and FIBC cutting machines
items.quote: These included the multi-layer coating line, CoEx 1600, developed for demanding high-barrier applications in the flexible packaging industry, and our nova 6 plus, a high-speed six-shuttle circular loom with maximum weft insertion speed of up to 1,150 picks per minute.

items.statement: Margins subject to raw material price volatility, geopolitical risks, and currency fluctuations
items.quote: In this world which is so changing fast, wars are happening in everywhere. So, one war ends and another war starts. The long-term impact of the movement of raw material or the parts, and China is also very strong player, what they supply and what they don't supply, all these will play a role in deciding the margins.

items.statement: Capacity utilization at 70-72%, can reach 85%; execution cycle 6-9 months for new orders
items.quote: We are currently operating at around 70%, 72% of capacity. And what we earlier said is that we can reach up to ideal capacity of around 85%.

items.statement: Spare parts revenue 2-3% of installed plant value annually; spare parts gross margins 2-3% higher than machinery
items.quote: We believe that around 2% to 3%, 3% approximately would be our revenue from the parts that he would require after commissioning every year, which are consumable parts.

items.statement: Recycling machinery (polyolefin) currently 5-6% of revenue; targeting material contribution going forward
items.quote: Around 10% to 12% would be coming from the spare parts, and the balance 5%, 6% would be coming from these new initiatives that we have taken. But we believe that going forward, this will form a substantial, I mean, material part of the revenue offerings.

items.statement: Plans to spend about INR4,000 crores capex over next 3-4 years while adding 3,000 beds.
items.quote: We have in the next 3-4 years as we add the 3,000 beds, we will spend around INR4,000 crores of capex.

items.statement: Current year capex expected at about INR2,000 crores, with INR900 crores already spent in Q1.
items.quote: As far as the capex for the current year is concerned, I think so current year, we will end up spending almost INR2,000 crores of capex because of the greenfields and brownfields that are coming up.

items.statement: Comfortable operating at 1.5-2x leverage; may go higher only for a must-take opportunity.
items.quote: Otherwise, we are fairly comfortable operating at 1.5 to 2 leverage, Aman.

items.statement: Sahyadri integration planned over 18 months; margins to move closer to portfolio level over next few quarters.
items.quote: At Sahyadri, like Karthik mentioned earlier, as those initiatives take shape over the next few quarters, we expect to push up Sahyadri closer to where the portfolio is.

items.statement: No specific margin number or timeline guided; aims to push network margins toward 30-32% levels seen at some hospitals.
items.quote: We don't want to indicate a specific number where we will get to, but when we look at our portfolio, like I mentioned, we have hospitals at 30% margin, in excess of 30% margin, several hospitals greater than 30-32% margin.

items.statement: Q1 ex-Sahyadri margin 25% vs 26.5% last year; dip due to one-off and greenfield doctor costs.
items.quote: So, Shyam, you know, if you could look at the last year versus this year ex-Sahyadri margin, last year Q1 was 26.5%, this year Q1 is 25%.

items.statement: Sahyadri Q1 EBITDA margin reached about 17.5%, a significant improvement.
items.quote: We have reached EBITDA margins of almost 17.5% in the first quarter, which is a significant growth, like I probably mentioned earlier.

items.statement: Q1 growth was volume-led; management sees these trends as sustainable tailwinds, not one-offs.
items.quote: So, the Q1 trends are not one -off trends. These are fairly secular kind of tailwinds that we see for Manipal.

items.statement: Centres of Excellence (CONGO-R) revenue contribution rose to about 65% in Q1 FY27.
items.quote: Our Centres of Excellence, the six centres that we consider as our high -acuity specialties -- Cardiology, Cardiac Sciences actually, Oncology, Neurology, Gastroenterology, Orthopaedics, and Renal Sciences continue to be a key growth driver, their revenue contribution rising to about 65% in Q1 of FY27.

items.statement: Oncology share of network revenue rose to 12.2% from 10.8% last year.
items.quote: You could see that from 10.8% in last year, it has already grown to 12.2% at a network level.

items.statement: Bed additions: Electronic City ~300 beds in Q2, Raipur in Q4 FY27, Nashik 103 beds already added.
items.quote: So, Bansi, the near 300-bed addition in terms of our Electronic City facility, which came up in Q2, that will happen. And we're expecting Raipur to get commissioned in, the Q4 of FY27.

items.statement: Government scheme patient collections were slow in Q1, similar to broader sector; expected to improve through the year.
items.quote: The other difference would be, Shyam, that in Q1, some of the collection, particularly the scheme patients collection has been a little slow, like the whole sector has been talking about.

items.statement: No plans to bring medical colleges into the listed entity; will stay focused on tertiary/quaternary hospitals.
items.quote: No, Karan. We have no such plans. You know, we believe Manipal Health Enterprises should remain focused on providing the highest end of tertiary and quaternary care, the brick-and -mortar hospitals that we run.

items.statement: Raises revenue growth guidance to high teens for next few quarters, retaining 20% underlying EBITDA margin guidance.
items.quote: Based on our recent performance and the current environment, we are raising our growth guidance to high teens for next few quarters while holding on to our margin range of underlying 20% EBITDA.

items.statement: Holds underlying EBITDA margin guidance at 20% going forward.
items.quote: Having said this, on margin, we are holding on to our guidance of 20% underlying margin in terms of EBITDA, and this is something which we will sustain as we go forward.

items.statement: PAT on track for double-digit growth for the full year despite Q1 decline.
items.quote: PAT delivery was in line with our estimates and is on track to deliver double-digit growth in the full year.

items.statement: Passed on entire cost increase including raw material, freight and currency through pricing.
items.quote: We were able to pass on the entire cost increase through judicious pricing across all our regions and customers.

items.statement: Europe margins expected to recover to mid-teens target range in coming quarters.
items.quote: And I think in the coming quarters, we will see Europe margins improving to our target range of mid-teens.

items.statement: Plans to double B&C market share from 8% to 16% in next few years.
items.quote: Currently, our market share is 8%. This, we believe, can go up to 16%.

items.statement: B&C growth momentum to sustain on healthy demand and investments; Oral recovering strongly.
items.quote: And with demand remaining healthy and our investments continuing to contribute, we expect this momentum to sustain.

items.statement: Merger with Indovida on track within planned timeline; CCI approval received.
items.quote: During the quarter, we received approval from the Competition Commission of India and the transaction continues to progress well. We remain on track to complete it within our planned timeline

items.statement: Actively scouting acquisitions in new formats and new markets.
items.quote: We are interested in moving into new formats, and we actively are scouting for opportunities for acquisition.

items.statement: Effective tax rate expected at 20-22% for full year.
items.quote: I think this year, on a full year basis, we should land anywhere between 20% to 22%.

items.statement: Expects high inflationary environment to persist for some time.
items.quote: At this stage, we expect to operate in a high inflationary environment for some time.

items.statement: Steady-state EBITDA expected to grow faster than revenue.
items.quote: On a steady-state basis, our EBITDA will grow faster than our revenue growth.

items.statement: Sustainable tubes now 44% of overall product mix.
items.quote: We continue to make meaningful progress on our sustainability agenda with sustainable tubes now accounting for 44% of our overall product mix.

items.statement: Thailand operations ramping up as new growth driver in significant B&C market.
items.quote: Our Thailand operations are beginning to ramp up, and Thailand is a really significant B&C market, and this ramp-up will be another growth driver as we go forward.

items.statement: Management expects to sustain current growth momentum through the rest of the year, with new programs fueling H2 growth.
items.quote: I don't see any challenges for us to sustain this growth momentum through the rest of this year in automotive.

items.statement: Group plans about Rs 15 crore capex this year; Rs 10 crore automotive, Rs 5 crore metals.
items.quote: CapEx wise at the group level, we want to invest about 15 cores this year. I would say about about 10 crores would go into the automotive segment, about five cores would go into Future tech which is the metal segment.

items.statement: Strong demand continues in Q2 for both automotive and metals segments.
items.quote: So broadly I would say strong demand continues even now in Q2 with both automotive and metals, right.

items.statement: Gross margin decline is commodity pass-through, not erosion; absolute margins remain stable.
items.quote: It's not really erosion in margin, right. This is just the impact of commodities.

items.statement: Copper and brass prices nearly doubled in twelve months, with some quarters seeing 10-30% increases.
items.quote: Over the last one year, I would say, copper prices, brass prices have almost doubled, right, in just twelve months.

items.statement: Automotive capacity utilization exceeds 85-90% in tubeless, TPMS and EV segments; tube valve still has room.
items.quote: when it comes to tubeless, TPMS and even maybe the EV segment, we are kind of, you know, running at capacity utilization levels in excess of 85-90 %, right.

items.statement: Received LOIs from AUMOVIO and SENSATA; BOSCH existing customer scaling up.
items.quote: We've received some LOIs from AUMOVIO and SENSATA these are two large global players in the TPMS census base and BOSCH, of course, is our existing customer also scaling up right now.

items.statement: Metals segment moving up value chain into special alloys with better margins, requiring foundry and extrusion equipment.
items.quote: we are now moving towards you know special alloys where there are some special alloying elements or the copper percentage is going up right, where margins are better

items.statement: Geopolitical supply chain disruptions expected over next 5-10 years; company offers vertically integrated de-risked solution.
items.quote: It's it's going to be a difficult time over the next 05-10 years.

items.statement: New EV components (charging infrastructure, motor control, battery terminals) expected to commercialize in 6-12 months.
items.quote: I would say typically six to twelve months, right. Sometimes even more.

items.statement: Debt to EBITDA targeted between 2.5 and 3 by end of year.
items.value: two and a half to three
items.quote: We are trying our best to bring that under three maybe somewhere between two and a half to three by the end of the year.

items.statement: Q1 group growth 38% YoY; about 20% volume growth, rest value growth.
items.quote: I'd say about 20 % is volume growth and the rest is, I would say value growth.

items.statement: Metals segment had slow Q1 start due to war impact; Rs 10 crore export sales undelivered.
items.quote: we have un-delivered because the Hormuz situation, sale of 10 crores not delivered on time even though we dispatch.

items.statement: FY27 revenue target is to be higher than the previous year; internal projections not disclosed.
items.quote: Yeah, so our FY 27 revenue target is that we want to be higher than the previous year, right and yeah, so jokes apart I you know, we have a lot of internal projections, but just in the interest of, you know, this is obviously completely confidential, I don't want to comment about it.

items.statement: Expects to do slightly better than annualized Q1 revenue, EBITDA and PBT this year.
items.quote: But except for Pat, if you look at PBT, beta, and revenue, I think we will do slightly better than the annualized number. So e.g., you take one 86 crores as the top line growth group console multiply by four will be somewhere higher than that and the same goes for EBITDA and PBT.

items.statement: Targets EV component vertical to reach about 100 crores over next few quarters, maybe by next year.
items.quote: See, we want to build up the EV component vertical to about hundred crores over the next few quarters. Maybe by next year we are we are trying to see whether we can grow that to about hundred crores.

items.statement: Climate control vertical should scale to about 100 crores if trade remediation and government import curbs happen.
items.quote: then we should see climate control vertical also growing to about a hundred crores very quickly because we have capacity, right, we have capacities.

items.statement: Targets 1,000 crore revenue by FY30 with plan B and C even if climatech does not pick up.
items.quote: So I'll put it this way in terms of hitting thousand crores, we have a plan for hitting thousand crores whether climatech picks up or not.

items.statement: Of 15 crores capex, 50-60% to commercialize this year, rest in FY28.
items.quote: Yeah, so I would say that, if I look at let's say 15 crowds going in, about 50 to 60 % of that will try will get commercialized in the current year itself. The rest will go into FY 28.

items.statement: Double-digit margin only when commodity prices stabilize; long game, not in next few quarters.
items.quote: Possibly that will only happen when commodity price is little bit stabilized, right. Once, you know, once you start looking at everything at constant price, then you will start seeing that percentage number creeping up.

items.statement: Absolute EBITDA run rate at 50 crores annualized vs 40 crores previous year; percentage margins optically eroded by commodity.
items.quote: Even if I were to annualize the Q1 number, obviously our ambition is to do much more than that. But even if I just take the Q1 number and annualize it, you'll realize we are somewhere close to the 50 core mark, right up from 40 cores in the previous year.

items.statement: Prices changed every three months with automotive and climate control customers; commodity spikes cause optical margin erosion.
items.quote: There will always be a catch up, right because with our automotive customers, even with our climate control customers, we change prices every three months.

items.statement: Metals expected to become 60%+ of group revenue over 2-3 years; other two verticals 40-45%.
items.quote: So, so whether we like it or not, I think metals, the way I look at over two, three years, how it will evolve, assuming that the current trend continues will be that metals will be probably 60 % plus of the group revenue and the other two will constitute the remaining 40-45 %.

items.statement: EV two-wheeler electrification to rise from 10% to 20-25% in one to one-and-a-half years.
items.quote: I can't name anybody specifically but tends to indicate that this 10 % is very quickly going to go to about 20-25 %, right. It's possibly going to happen over just maybe one, one and a half years, right.

items.statement: Q2 expected reasonably good; Q3 seasonal dip expected, climate control and metals to show traction in Q3.
items.quote: Q3 onwards once the festival season gets over, we should expect a seasonal dip, right. So we should be prepared for that.

items.statement: ROCE to move from 12.5% to 13-14% this year, 15% by mid next year; new investments target 20-25% ROCE.
items.quote: You can see right we've already moved up to about twelve and a half percent in Q. One. We are able to continue the momentum going into Q2-Q3-Q4, I think we should see twelve and a half going to maybe 13-14 % this year itself, right?

items.statement: Feed sales expected around 5,85,000 MT in FY27.
items.quote: It is estimated that the feed sales during FY27 would be around 5,85,000 MTs.

items.statement: Shrimp exports expected around 19,000 MT in FY27.
items.quote: It is estimated that exports during FY27 would be around 19,000 MTs.

items.statement: Pet food project estimated investment around INR 175 crores; land purchased for INR 25 crores.
items.quote: We are estimating around INR 175 crores investment in a pet food. Till now, we have purchased land around INR 25 crores worth of land.

items.statement: Feed price hike of around 10% taken in June.
items.quote: Around 10%, we have taken.

items.statement: PBT margin declined to 7.06% in Q1 FY27 from 13% in Q4 FY26 and 17% in Q1 FY26.
items.quote: The PBT during the quarter stood at 7.06% on revenue as compared to about 13% during Q4 FY 26 and 17% during Q1 FY26.

items.statement: FY26/27 expected challenging for aquaculture due to high feed raw material prices and export demand issues.
items.quote: To sum up, in general, FY 26/27 is expected to be a challenging season for the aquaculture industry in respect of shrimp production due to steep increase in feed raw material prices as well as exports from India and global demand for shrimp exports.

items.statement: Shrimp culture activity progressing well; farmers happy with favorable climate and farm-gate prices.
items.quote: At present, the shrimp culture activity is very good. The farmers are very happy that the culture is progressing very well with the climate is also favorable. Farm-gate prices have also been have gone up.

items.statement: Raw material prices expected to stabilize in coming months upon fresh crops arrival.
items.quote: However, due to favorable monsoon across India, El Nino effects are expected to ease and raw material prices of shrimp feed are expected to stabilize in coming months upon arrival of fresh crops.

items.statement: Pet food sales increased to INR 180 lakh in Q1 FY27 from INR 151 lakh in Q4 FY26.
items.quote: Q1 FY26/27 sales increased to INR180 lakh compared to INR151 lakhs in Q4 FY25/26, reflecting continued growth in both cat food and dog food segment.

items.statement: Pet food manufacturing facility construction to commence after approval.
items.quote: Construction activity will commence upon receipt of the necessary approval.

items.statement: US reciprocal tariff refunds pending due to ADD/CVD suspension; entries declared but not processed.
items.quote: Regarding reciprocal tariff, particularly for seafood industry, that too for India, so now the entries are under ADD and the CVD review, which are under suspension status. Unless the suspension is lifted, the CBP will not process the reciprocal tariffs. As of now, they're all under pending status.

items.statement: Shrimp production estimated 8-9 lakh MT in CY2026; feed consumption 11-12 lakh MT.
items.quote: On the basis of estimated shrimp production of about 8-9 lakh MTs in calendar year 2026, the feed consumption is estimated to be about 1 1-12 lakh MTs.

items.statement: Government committee with consultant working on feed price mechanism.
items.quote: The government has, in fact, constituted a committee with one of the big four consultants. They are working on that how to handle this at the price because we have to keep in view not only the feed manufacturers, but also to the farmers and also how it becomes a sustainable activity for the farmers.

items.statement: Targets INR5,000 crore revenue by 2030 with 25-30% annual growth.
items.quote: Your company is poised to achieve a revenue mark of INR5,000 crores by 2030. We are targeting annual revenue growth of approximately 25% to 30%, supported by our strong B2B foundation, expanding B2C and digital ecosystem and value creation across every segment of the business.

items.statement: Expects 30% overall top-line growth for the full year.
items.quote: In that case, yes, that overall today's top line, if you consider, we would be able to achieve 30% growth.

items.statement: Plans 8-10 new stores over 3-4 years; retail to reach 40% of revenue by FY2030.
items.quote: B2C business will be the key growth driver going forward, and we have a very aggressive plan to launch 8 to 10 stores over the next 3 to 4 years across geographies.

items.statement: Retail share targeted at 40% of overall revenue by FY2030.
items.quote: Our retail expansion is aimed to accelerating our B2C growth and increasing the B2C contribution to approximately 40% of overall revenue by FY 2030.

items.statement: Rising retail share expected to lift overall EBITDA and PAT margins.
items.quote: Since the overall share of the retail is going to increase to 40%, we are targeting to reach at least 40% of the retail sale by FY 2030. So in that case, the share of retail increases, then our margins of what they say, retail sale will be -- our margins -- retail margins will be high.

items.statement: Flagship showroom achieving 80-85% of INR500 crore revenue target; monthly run rate INR30-35 crore.
items.quote: We have already defined that the showroom is going to fetch us in a revenue of around INR500 crores and somewhere around 80% to 85% of that we have been working, and we are achieving that.

items.statement: Q1 jewellery volume/quantum growth was around 15%.
items.quote: So the growth in the quantum was around 15%.

items.statement: Main board migration process expected to complete in about 2 months.
items.quote: Surely, we would be -- the migration process will be completed in another 2 months, we believe.

items.statement: New stores to be company-owned initially, using asset-light leased model.
items.quote: We said no, we are going to operate with an asset-light model so that we will have and leased the property for that and use it for our development.

items.statement: Expansion funded via internal earnings; debt may be raised if required.
items.quote: We are planning a retail development of 40% to reach there, we have our internal earnings, we will be utilizing it for expansion. And certain cases, as and when required by the required, the management will be deciding as and when it may be raised by debt or some other means.

items.statement: Steep gold price rises cause 1-2 week demand slowdown before normalizing.
items.quote: And every time when there is a steep rise in the prices, yes, there is a certain slowdown of, say, for a fortnight or 2 weeks. Then that price get digested.

items.statement: Sources products at lower making charges than market, offering better pricing than peers.
items.quote: And competitively, we are able to source the right product at the right making charge a lower making charge compared to the market since we have been dealing with both B2B and B2C segment.

items.statement: Added Kundan Jadau and diamond jewellery in B2B to improve margins.
items.quote: So we have added up Kundan Jadau jewellery and even diamond jewellery for our B2B segment also. So we have been working on improving the margins of B2B.

items.statement: Old gold exchange is 15-20% of total sales, up from last year.
items.quote: So the old gold exchange is total -- out of the total sale, old gold exchange is somewhere around 15% to 20%. Now it has increased. Last year, it was less after the Modi ji statement, it has increased.

items.statement: New programs with Mahindra, Tata Motors, Maruti Suzuki started production; volumes expected to progressively ramp up.
items.quote: Several new programs with our key customers, including Mahindra, Tata Motors, Maruti Suzuki, have started production during this quarter.

items.statement: Several new programs in pipeline expected to commence production in coming quarters.
items.quote: In addition to these programs that have already commenced, we have several ofher new programs in the pipeline with a number of them expected to commence production in the coming quarters.

items.statement: Investing ahead of customer requirements in capacity additions, automation, and technology upgrades.
items.quote: Our customers are significantly investing in additional capacity, new vehicle programs, and localization, and we are investing ahead of these requirements in capacity additions, automation, and technology upgrades.

items.statement: Cautious near-term outlook for EMOSS Europe due to EV commercial vehicle slowdown and reduced program visibility.
items.quote: As a result, we remain cautious about the near-term outlook for EMOSS Europe.

items.statement: EMOSS revenue fell to INR13.8 crores in Q1 from INR29 crores previous quarter; management taking cautious view.
items.quote: the business reported a revenue of INR13.8 crores during the quarter compared to INR29 crores in the previous quarter.

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin 13%, PAT margin 9% in Q1.
items.quote: the total income increased by 6.6% quarter-on-quarter to INR173 crores, EBITDA margin stood at 13%, and PAT margin stood at 9%.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin about 10%, PAT about 4.2%.
items.quote: The consolidated business decreased by 2.4% and was at INR200.8 crores, EBITDA margin was about 10%, and profit after tax was about 4.2%.

items.statement: Standalone total income grew 6.6% QoQ to INR173 crores; net profit INR14.88 crores, up 12.5%.
items.quote: The company's total income stood at INR173 crores, registering a growth of 6.6% compared to the last quarter.

items.statement: MEMCO recorded revenue of INR14 crores in Q1, focusing on Bosch, Delphi, Endress+Hauser relationships.
items.quote: Our subsidiary MEMCO recorded a revenue of INR14 crores during Q1 and continues to focus on strengthening relationships with key customers like Bosch, Delphi, Endress+Hauser, and a few others.

items.statement: Actively evaluating acquisition opportunities within India to grow into new products, markets, and customers.
items.quote: We are also actively looking at acquisition opportunities within India, and that will be a way for us to grow into new products, new markets, new customers, and so on.

items.statement: European automotive industry restructuring and slower EV customer decision-making reduce program visibility.
items.quote: Against this backdrop, customer decision-making in the EV segment has become slower and program visibility has reduced.

items.statement: EHCV platform developed and delivered to a customer, currently undergoing evaluation and field trials.
items.quote: We have developed the EHCV platform and delivered the vehicle to a customer, and the customer is still undergoing evaluation and field trials at this point.

items.statement: Focus on protecting EMOSS business, managing costs and investments, evaluating based on customer traction and returns.
items.quote: Our focus at this point is protecting the business and carefully managing costs and investments, and we will continue to evaluate the business based on customer fraction, cash requirements, and potential returns.
